tench: The tench has a deep olive-brown body, densely packed fine scales, reddish eyes, a short barbel at each corner of the mouth, and rounded fins.
goldfish: The goldfish has an orange, gold, white, or black-scaled body, a rounded head, prominent eyes, and broad translucent fins; some forms have paired, elongated tail lobes.
great white shark: The great white shark has a spindle-shaped body, a pointed conical snout, a gray back, a white underside, a triangular dorsal fin, and a crescent-shaped tail.
tiger shark: The tiger shark has a broad blunt snout, a gray back with dark vertical bars or blotches, a pale underside, and a tail with an elongated upper lobe.
hammerhead shark: The hammerhead shark has a head extended sideways into a flattened bar, eyes at the outer ends, a gray tapered body, and a tall triangular dorsal fin.
electric ray: The electric ray has a thick rounded body disc, eyes on its upper surface, and a short stout tail bearing dorsal fins and a broad terminal fin.
stingray: The stingray has a flattened diamond-shaped or rounded body disc, eyes on top, and a narrow whip-shaped tail that is much thinner than the body.
rooster: The rooster has a prominent red comb and hanging wattles, pointed neck feathers, curved elongated tail feathers, and bare scaly legs, often with projecting spurs.
hen: The hen has a rounded feathered body, a short arched tail, a comparatively low comb, hanging wattles, and bare scaly legs beneath broad overlapping flank feathers.
ostrich: The ostrich has an oval feathered body, a long sparsely feathered neck, a proportionally small head, long bare legs, and two forward-pointing toes on each foot.
brambling: The brambling has an orange breast and shoulder patches, a white belly and rump, dark wings with pale bars, and a short conical bill.
goldfinch: The goldfinch has a red face bordered by white and black, a tan back, pale underparts, black wings with a broad yellow band, and a pointed pale bill.
house finch: The house finch has a thick conical bill, brown streaked wings and flanks, and a shallowly notched tail; red coloration may cover the forehead, breast, and rump.
junco: The junco has a short pale pink bill, a dark gray or brown hood and back, a contrasting pale belly, and white outer tail feathers.
indigo bunting: The indigo bunting has a compact body, a short conical bill, and dark wings edged in blue or brown; plumage can be blue overall or brown with faint breast streaks.
American robin: The American robin has a gray-brown back, an orange-red breast, a darker head, a yellow bill, white eye arcs, and a white patch beneath the tail.
bulbul: The bulbul has a slender dark bill, a relatively long tail, a rounded or pointed feather crest, and brown or olive plumage, often with a contrasting pale throat.
jay: The jay has blue upperparts, a pointed crest, a black band across the neck and chest, pale underparts, and blue wings and tail marked with black bars and white patches.
magpie: The magpie has a black head and chest, a white belly and shoulder patches, and a long graduated tail with blue-green sheen on the dark feathers.
chickadee: The chickadee has a black cap and throat patch, white cheeks, a gray back, pale underparts, a short dark bill, and a narrow tail.
American dipper: The American dipper has a rounded slate-gray body, a darker head, a straight dark bill, a short tail, and relatively long bare legs with slender toes.
kite (bird of prey): The kite has a hooked bill, long angular wings, a gray or brown body, and a notched or forked tail, with dark streaks or patches across the plumage.
bald eagle: The bald eagle has a white feathered head and tail, a dark brown body and wings, a deep yellow hooked bill, and yellow feet with curved dark claws.
vulture: The vulture has a sparsely feathered head, a hooked bill, a thick feathered body, broad dark wings, and a ring or ruff of feathers around the lower neck.
great grey owl: The great grey owl has a broad circular gray facial disc with concentric dark rings, yellow eyes, a white bow-shaped throat marking, and densely streaked gray-brown plumage.
fire salamander: The fire salamander has a broad rounded head, short legs, a thick tapering tail, and glossy black skin with irregular yellow patches or broken yellow bands.
smooth newt: The smooth newt has a slender brown body, dark round spots, a pale orange belly, and a flattened tail; some individuals have a continuous wavy crest along the back and tail.
newt: The newt has an elongated body, four short splayed legs, rounded toes, a blunt head, and a long flattened tail, with brown, orange, or dark spotted skin.
spotted salamander: The spotted salamander has a stout black or slate-gray body, two uneven rows of rounded yellow spots, a broad head, short legs, and a tapering tail.
axolotl: The axolotl has a broad flattened head, three branching external gill stalks on each side, short slender legs, and a long tail bordered by a translucent fin.
American bullfrog: The American bullfrog has a broad green or brown head, prominent eyes, round patches behind the eyes, a pale throat, and long folded hind legs beneath a thick body.
tree frog: The tree frog has a compact body, slender limbs, long toes with rounded expanded tips, prominent eyes, and green, brown, or mottled skin.
tailed frog: The tailed frog has a flattened brown or gray body, granular skin, vertical pupils, and long hind toes; some individuals have a short tail-like projection between the rear legs.
loggerhead sea turtle: The loggerhead sea turtle has a broad block-shaped head, a reddish-brown shell with large polygonal plates, a pale underside, and flattened paddle-shaped limbs.
leatherback sea turtle: The leatherback sea turtle has a dark elongated shell with seven lengthwise ridges, scattered pale speckles, a tapered rear outline, and long pointed front flippers.
mud turtle: The mud turtle has an oval domed brown or black shell, a blunt head with pale flecks or stripes, short legs, and webbed toes with visible claws.
terrapin: The terrapin has a gray head and legs patterned with dark spots or flecks, webbed feet, and a shell of polygonal plates marked by concentric rings.
box turtle: The box turtle has a high domed shell with yellow or orange patches on a dark background, a short beaked head, and stout legs with separate clawed toes.
banded gecko: The banded gecko has a slender pale body crossed by dark brown bands, large eyes with vertical pupils, fine granular skin, and a thick tapering tail.
green iguana: The green iguana has a row of pointed spines along its back, a hanging throat fold, a large round cheek scale, long clawed toes, and a banded tapering tail.
Carolina anole: The Carolina anole has a slender green or brown body, a long pointed snout, expanded toe tips, and a thin tapering tail; an extended throat flap is pink or red.
desert grassland whiptail lizard: The desert grassland whiptail lizard has a slim brown body with six pale lengthwise stripes, a pointed snout, slender limbs, and a tail much longer than its torso.
agama: The agama has a triangular head, granular scales, a stocky torso, long toes, and a tapering tail; some individuals have an orange-red head and a blue body.
frilled-necked lizard: The frilled-necked lizard has a broad pleated collar around its neck, a narrow brown head, long slender legs, and a tapering tail longer than its torso.
alligator lizard: The alligator lizard has an elongated body with rectangular ridged scales, a wedge-shaped head, short legs, and a long tapering tail, often with dark transverse bands.
Gila monster: The Gila monster has a broad blunt head, a thick cylindrical tail, short splayed legs, and rounded bead-like scales arranged in black and orange or pink patches.
European green lizard: The European green lizard has a green body with fine dark speckles, a tapered head, well-defined legs, and a long narrow tail; the throat may be blue.
chameleon: The chameleon has a laterally flattened body, bulging turret-shaped eyes, toes grouped into opposing bundles, a curved or coiled tail, and a raised ridge along the head or back.
Komodo dragon: The Komodo dragon has a broad elongated head, gray-brown pebbled skin, a thick neck, stout limbs with long curved claws, and a thick tapering tail.
Nile crocodile: The Nile crocodile has an elongated tapered snout, olive-brown armored skin, raised rectangular back plates, and lower teeth visible along the edges of the closed jaws.
American alligator: The American alligator has a broad rounded U-shaped snout, dark gray armored skin, raised back plates, and a thick flattened tail with paired ridges near its base.
triceratops: The triceratops has a broad frill behind the head, two long horns above the eyes, a shorter nose horn, a beaked snout, and a bulky four-legged body.
worm snake: The worm snake has a slender cylindrical brown body, a small rounded head barely wider than the neck, tiny dark eyes, a pink underside, and a pointed tail tip.
ring-necked snake: The ring-necked snake has a slender gray or black body, a narrow yellow or orange collar behind the head, and a contrasting yellow-orange underside.
eastern hog-nosed snake: The eastern hog-nosed snake has a broad head with an upturned snout, a thick body with ridged scales, and brown, gray, or black coloration, often with dark blotches.
smooth green snake: The smooth green snake has a slender uniformly green body, a pale yellow or white underside, a narrow head with round pupils, and a long tapering tail.
kingsnake: The kingsnake has glossy scales, a rounded head, and a cylindrical body marked with contrasting rings, narrow crossbands, or pale chain-shaped markings on a dark background.
garter snake: The garter snake has a slender body with ridged scales, a narrow head, and three pale lengthwise stripes, often bordered by rows of dark checkerboard markings.
water snake: The water snake has a thick body with ridged scales, a broad head, and dark crossbands or alternating blotches over brown, gray, or reddish coloration.
vine snake: The vine snake has an slender body, an elongated pointed head, prominent eyes, and a long threadlike tail, with green or brown coloration along its narrow profile.
night snake: The night snake has a pale gray or tan body with rows of brown blotches, vertical pupils, a dark stripe behind each eye, and dark patches behind the head.
boa constrictor: The boa constrictor has a thick tan body with dark saddle-shaped back markings, a long triangular head, and a tapered tail bearing broad reddish-brown patches.
African rock python: The African rock python has a thick body with irregular dark-edged brown patches on a tan background, a triangular head, and a dark stripe through each eye.
Indian cobra: The Indian cobra has an elongated brown or black body and a broad flattened neck hood, often bearing a pale spectacle-shaped marking on its rear surface.
green mamba: The green mamba has an elongated narrow head, round dark pupils, a slender green body with overlapping scales, and a long evenly tapering tail.
sea snake: The sea snake has an elongated scaled body, a head narrower than its midsection, and a vertically flattened paddle-shaped tail, often with dark transverse bands.
Saharan horned viper: The Saharan horned viper has a broad triangular head, a short thick sandy-colored body, ridged scales, and often a pointed horn-like scale above each eye.
eastern diamondback rattlesnake: The eastern diamondback rattlesnake has a thick brown body patterned with pale-edged dark diamonds, a broad triangular head, a dark cheek stripe, and a segmented tail rattle.
sidewinder rattlesnake: The sidewinder rattlesnake has a sandy-colored body with rows of brown blotches, raised pointed scales above the eyes, a triangular head, and a short segmented tail rattle.
trilobite: The trilobite has an oval shell divided lengthwise into a raised central lobe and two side lobes, with many transverse segments and a broad curved head shield.
harvestman: The harvestman has a compact oval body without a narrow waist and eight slender jointed legs extending far beyond the body, often with dark bands at the joints.
scorpion: The scorpion has two prominent front pincers, four pairs of legs, a flattened segmented body, and a narrow jointed tail ending in a curved pointed tip.
yellow garden spider: The yellow garden spider has an elongated black abdomen with paired yellow patches, a pale silvery front body section, and eight long legs with black and yellow-orange bands.
barn spider: The barn spider has a rounded brown abdomen with a dark wavy-edged central marking, pale speckles, and eight hairy legs marked with alternating light and dark bands.
European garden spider: The European garden spider has a rounded tapering brown abdomen with white spots arranged in a cross, and eight spiny legs with dark bands.
southern black widow: The southern black widow has a glossy black rounded abdomen, a much smaller front body section, long slender legs, and a red hourglass marking on the underside.
tarantula: The tarantula has a broad hairy front body section, a rounded hairy abdomen, eight thick jointed legs, and two shorter leg-like appendages beside its mouth.
wolf spider: The wolf spider has a hairy brown or gray body, longitudinal dark stripes, thick banded legs, and two prominent forward-facing eyes above a row of four smaller eyes.
tick: The tick has a flattened oval or rounded body, a small projecting mouthpart cluster, and eight short jointed legs grouped toward the front half of the body.
centipede: The centipede has a long flattened body divided into repeated segments, one pair of legs on each leg-bearing segment, long antennae, and elongated rear legs.
black grouse: The black grouse has a compact body, red eyebrow patches, and dark plumage with white wing markings; the outer tail feathers curve outward into a lyre-shaped outline.
ptarmigan: The ptarmigan has a rounded body, a short dark bill, feathered legs and toes, and dark outer tail feathers, with white, mottled brown, or mixed plumage.
ruffed grouse: The ruffed grouse has mottled brown-gray plumage, a short pointed crest, dark elongated neck feathers, and a broad fan-shaped tail with a dark band near its edge.
prairie grouse: The prairie grouse has a rounded body with dense brown and pale horizontal barring, a short rounded tail, and elongated pointed neck feathers beside orange-yellow neck patches.
peafowl: The peafowl has a slender neck and upright head crest; some individuals have a blue neck and an elongated train of green-gold feathers with circular blue-centered eyespots.
quail: The quail has a rounded body, a short tail, a short curved bill, and patterned brown-gray plumage; some forms have a forward-curving dark head plume.
partridge: The partridge has a plump oval body, a short rounded tail, a short thick bill, and gray-brown plumage with barred flanks and contrasting facial markings.
african grey parrot: The African grey parrot has layered gray feathers with pale scalloped edges, a pale face, a curved black bill, and a short red tail.
macaw: The macaw has a deep hooked bill, a bare pale facial patch, long pointed wings, and an elongated tapered tail, with broad areas of red, blue, green, or yellow plumage.
sulphur-crested cockatoo: The sulphur-crested cockatoo has white plumage, an upright curved yellow crest, a dark hooked bill, a round dark eye, and pale yellow beneath the wings and tail.
lorikeet: The lorikeet has a slender parrot-shaped body, a curved orange-red bill, a pointed tail, and green wings with contrasting blue, red, orange, or yellow plumage patches.
coucal: The coucal has a broad graduated black tail, a black head and underside, chestnut wings, red eyes, and a stout downward-curved dark bill.
bee eater: The bee eater has a slender body, a long slightly downward-curved bill, a dark stripe through the eye, pointed wings, and elongated central tail feathers.
hornbill: The hornbill has a deep downward-curved bill, often topped by a raised casque, a thick neck, a long tail, and contrasting dark and pale plumage.
hummingbird: The hummingbird has a narrow elongated bill, a compact body, slender pointed wings, short legs, and often a reflective green back with a contrasting throat patch.
jacamar: The jacamar has an elongated straight pointed bill, a slender green-bronze body, a long narrow tail, and a chestnut underside, often with a pale throat patch.
toucan: The toucan has a deep bill longer than the head with a curved upper edge, a dark feathered body, a contrasting pale or yellow throat, and bare colored skin around the eyes.
duck: The duck has a broad flattened bill, an oval body, a short tail, short legs, and webbed feet, with overlapping wing feathers forming a compact side panel.
red-breasted merganser: The red-breasted merganser has a narrow red bill, a wispy rear head crest, and an elongated body; some individuals have a dark green head, white collar, and rusty breast.
goose: The goose has a broad oval body, a long neck, a deep tapered bill, broad overlapping wing feathers, short legs, and webbed feet beneath the body.
black swan: The black swan has black plumage with curled back feathers, a long curved neck, a red bill with a pale tip, and white flight feathers visible in an open wing.
tusker: The tusker has a deep rounded gray body, deeply creased skin, broad ears, a long trunk, and prominent curved ivory-colored tusks extending from either side of the trunk.
echidna: The echidna has a low rounded body covered with pale-tipped spines and brown hair, a long narrow snout, short legs, and broad feet with curved claws.
platypus: The platypus has a broad flat bill, a low brown-furred body, short webbed feet, and a broad flattened tail with a rounded end.
wallaby: The wallaby has a narrow muzzle, upright oval ears, short forelimbs, long folded hind legs, elongated hind feet, and a thick tapering tail beneath gray-brown fur.
koala: The koala has a rounded gray-furred body, broad furry ears, a prominent oval black nose, pale chest fur, and stout limbs with long curved dark claws.
wombat: The wombat has a barrel-shaped brown or gray body, a broad blunt head, short rounded ears, short thick legs, and a tail barely visible behind the rump.
jellyfish: The jellyfish has a translucent bell-shaped or domed body with a circular rim, trailing threadlike tentacles, and thicker folded or ribbon-shaped appendages beneath the bell.
sea anemone: The sea anemone has a cylindrical base topped by a circular disc, with numerous finger-shaped tentacles arranged in rings around a central opening.
brain coral: The brain coral forms a rounded mound covered by continuous winding ridges and narrow grooves, producing a dense maze-like pattern across its tan, green, or brown surface.
flatworm: The flatworm has a thin flattened ribbon-shaped or leaf-shaped body, a continuous unsegmented outline, and often wavy edges with contrasting stripes, spots, or colored borders.
nematode: The nematode has an elongated thread-shaped body with a cylindrical profile, a smooth unsegmented surface, and gradually tapered ends, usually white, pale, or translucent.
conch: The conch has a spiral shell with a pointed spire, raised knobs or ridges, and a broad flared opening bordered by a thick lip, often with a pink or cream-colored exposed lip.
snail: The snail has a rounded spiral shell above an elongated exposed body, a broad flat underside, and two pairs of head tentacles, with eyes at the longer pair's tips.
slug: The slug has an elongated shell-free body, a rounded mantle patch behind the head, two pairs of tentacles, and a tapering rear end with a continuous lower edge.
sea slug: The sea slug has an exposed elongated body with contrasting colored markings, paired horn-like head projections, and often branching back projections or a ruffled border.
chiton: The chiton has a flattened oval outline, eight overlapping transverse shell plates along its back, and a continuous thick border around the plates.
chambered nautilus: The chambered nautilus has a rounded spiral shell with reddish-brown bands on a cream background, a broad opening, and numerous slender tentacles clustered around the exposed head.
Dungeness crab: The Dungeness crab has a broad oval reddish-brown or purple shell with serrated side edges, pale-tipped claws, and four pairs of flattened pointed legs.
rock crab: The rock crab has a broad reddish or brown granular shell, a curved toothed front edge, thick claws with dark tips, and jointed legs extending from both sides.
fiddler crab: The fiddler crab has a boxy shell, long upright eyestalks, slender angular legs, and front claws that may be strongly unequal, with one greatly enlarged claw.
red king crab: The red king crab has a reddish-brown shell covered in pointed spines, long angular spiny legs, and unequal claws projecting from the front of its body.
American lobster: The American lobster has an elongated segmented shell, two enlarged front claws with different outlines, long thin antennae, stalked eyes, and a broad fan-shaped tail tip.
spiny lobster: The spiny lobster has a ridged spiny shell, elongated thick antennae, slender front legs without enlarged claws, and a segmented abdomen ending in a broad tail fan.
crayfish: The crayfish has a pointed snout, stalked eyes, long thin antennae, paired front pincers, and a narrow segmented abdomen ending in a fan-shaped tail.
hermit crab: The hermit crab has stalked eyes, long antennae, jointed legs, and unequal front pincers projecting from the opening of a coiled shell that covers the rear body.
isopod: The isopod has an oval flattened body covered by overlapping transverse plates, paired antennae, and seven pairs of short jointed legs arranged beneath the sides.
white stork: The white stork has white body plumage, broad black wing feathers, a long straight red bill, a long neck, and long bare red legs.
black stork: The black stork has a glossy black head, neck, back, and wings, a contrasting white belly, a long straight red bill, and long red legs.
spoonbill: The spoonbill has a long flat bill that broadens into a rounded spoon-shaped tip, a long neck, long bare legs, and white or pink plumage.
flamingo: The flamingo has pink or pale rose plumage, an elongated curved neck, elongated thin legs, and a deep bill with a sharply downward-bent black tip.
little blue heron: The little blue heron has a slender neck, long greenish legs, and a blue-gray bill with a dark tip; plumage may be slate-blue with a purplish head or white.
great egret: The great egret has white plumage, a long slender curved neck, a straight pointed yellow bill, and long black legs ending in dark splayed toes.
bittern bird: The bittern bird has a thick neck, a pointed straight bill, brown and buff streaked plumage, and elongated throat stripes extending into a rounded body.
crane bird: The crane bird has a long slender neck, an elongated straight bill, long bare legs, a short tail partly covered by drooping feathers, and gray or white plumage.
limpkin: The limpkin has brown plumage with narrow white spots and streaks, a long neck, long gray legs, and a slender slightly downward-curved bill.
common gallinule: The common gallinule has a dark gray body, a red forehead shield and bill with a yellow tip, white flank stripes, and long unwebbed yellow-green toes.
American coot: The American coot has a rounded slate-gray body, a darker head, a short white bill, a small dark forehead mark, and broad lobes along its toes.
bustard: The bustard has a deep rounded body, a long upright neck, a short tapered bill, long bare legs, and brown patterned upperparts above pale underparts.
ruddy turnstone: The ruddy turnstone has a short wedge-shaped dark bill, orange legs, a white belly, and a dark chest pattern below mottled chestnut, black, and white upperparts.
dunlin: The dunlin has a long dark bill with a downward-curved tip, dark legs, and gray or rusty patterned upperparts; some individuals have a broad black belly patch.
common redshank: The common redshank has long orange-red legs, a straight bill with a reddish base and dark tip, mottled gray-brown upperparts, and pale streaked underparts.
dowitcher: The dowitcher has a very long straight dark bill, a pale eyebrow stripe, a rounded mottled brown-gray body, and greenish legs, with bars or spots along the flanks.
oystercatcher: The oystercatcher has a long straight orange-red bill, pink legs, red-rimmed eyes, and a stocky black body, often with a contrasting white belly and wing stripe.
pelican: The pelican has an elongated flattened bill with a hooked tip, a deep pouch below the lower bill, a thick neck, broad wings, and short webbed feet.
king penguin: The king penguin has a black head, orange ear patches, a long narrow bill with an orange side stripe, gray back, white belly, and yellow-orange upper chest.
albatross: The albatross has very long narrow wings, a thick hooked bill with visible tubular nostrils, webbed feet, and contrasting pale body plumage and dark wing surfaces.
grey whale: The grey whale has a broad mottled gray back with pale patches and circular marks, a low dorsal hump followed by knuckles, and broad tail flukes.
killer whale: The killer whale has a black back, white oval patches behind the eyes, a white underside, broad rounded flippers, and a prominent upright dorsal fin.
dugong: The dugong has a gray spindle-shaped body, a broad downward-angled bristled muzzle, rounded front flippers, no dorsal fin, and a horizontally divided crescent-shaped tail.
sea lion: The sea lion has a tapered brown body, a rounded muzzle with pale whiskers, visible external ear flaps, long front flippers, and paired hind flippers.
Chihuahua: The Chihuahua has a rounded domed head, large upright ears, prominent round eyes, a short pointed muzzle, slender legs, and a curved tail above a compact body.
Japanese Chin: The Japanese Chin has a broad flat face, widely spaced round eyes, feathered hanging ears, and a long white coat with dark patches and a plumed tail over the back.
Maltese: The Maltese has an entirely white long straight coat, dark round eyes, a black nose, hanging ears hidden by hair, and a plumed tail curved over the back.
Pekingese: The Pekingese has a broad flat face, a dark wrinkled muzzle, a thick neck ruff, a long straight coat, and short bowed forelegs beneath a broad chest.
Shih Tzu: The Shih Tzu has a short broad muzzle, round dark eyes, long hair radiating around the face, a long straight body coat, and a plumed tail curled over the back.
King Charles Spaniel: The King Charles Spaniel has a domed skull, a short upturned muzzle, round dark eyes, long feathered hanging ears, and a compact body with a wavy patterned coat.
Papillon: The Papillon has large upright ears with long fringes, a fine pointed muzzle, a white coat with colored patches, and a feathered tail arched over its back.
toy terrier: The toy terrier has a smooth black coat with sharply bounded tan markings, a narrow wedge-shaped head, pointed upright ears, fine straight legs, and a tapering tail.
Rhodesian Ridgeback: The Rhodesian Ridgeback has a short wheaten coat, a clearly outlined ridge along the spine, a deep chest, folded triangular ears, and a long tapering tail.
Afghan Hound: The Afghan Hound has a narrow elongated face, a long straight coat over the body and hanging ears, slender legs, and a thin tail ending in a ring-shaped curve.
Basset Hound: The Basset Hound has an elongated deep body, very short legs, elongated hanging ears, loose facial folds, and a short patterned coat, often with a white-tipped tail.
Beagle: The Beagle has a compact rectangular body, a short tricolor or two-color coat, rounded hanging ears, a broad muzzle, and an upright tapered tail with a white tip.
Bloodhound: The Bloodhound has a long narrow head with deep skin folds, very long drooping ears, loose neck skin, hanging lips, and a short red or black-and-tan coat.
Bluetick Coonhound: The Bluetick Coonhound has a white coat densely flecked with dark blue-black ticking, broad black patches, tan facial markings, long hanging ears, and a deep narrow chest.
Black and Tan Coonhound: The Black and Tan Coonhound has a short black coat, tan eyebrows and muzzle markings, tan lower legs, a long broad muzzle, and long low-set hanging ears.
Treeing Walker Coonhound: The Treeing Walker Coonhound has long straight legs, a deep narrow chest, rounded hanging ears, and a short white coat with black saddle patches and tan head markings.
English foxhound: The English foxhound has a broad skull, a deep chest, straight thick-boned legs, rounded hanging ears, and a short white, black, and tan coat with large patches.
Redbone Coonhound: The Redbone Coonhound has a short red coat, a narrow rectangular body, a deep chest, a dark nose, long rounded hanging ears, and a slender tapered tail.
borzoi: The borzoi has a long narrow head with a gently arched muzzle, a deep chest, a strongly tucked abdomen, long wavy fur, and a low curved feathered tail.
Irish Wolfhound: The Irish Wolfhound has long legs, a deep chest, a long broad muzzle, a shaggy gray or brindled coat, bushy eyebrows, a beard, and small folded ears.
Italian Greyhound: The Italian Greyhound has fine legs, a narrow head, a smooth close coat, a curved back, a deep narrow chest, and a thin curved tail.
Whippet: The Whippet has a smooth close coat, a long narrow muzzle, folded ears, a deep chest, a sharply tucked waist, arched hindquarters, and a long slender tail.
Ibizan Hound: The Ibizan Hound has a narrow elongated head, very large upright ears, a pinkish nose, long straight legs, and a lean white-and-red body with a tapered tail.
Norwegian Elkhound: The Norwegian Elkhound has a dense gray coat with dark-tipped back hairs, a black muzzle, upright triangular ears, a compact body, and a tightly curled tail over its back.
Otterhound: The Otterhound has a shaggy coat, a broad bearded muzzle, long folded hanging ears, a deep body, broad paws, and a thickly coated tapering tail.
Saluki: The Saluki has a narrow elongated head, long hanging ears with fine feathering, a smooth slender torso, a deep chest, long fine legs, and a curved feathered tail.
Scottish Deerhound: The Scottish Deerhound has a narrow elongated muzzle, a shaggy gray coat, small folded ears, a deep chest, a tucked waist, long slender legs, and a low tapering tail.
Weimaraner: The Weimaraner has a close silver-gray coat, pale amber or gray eyes, a long straight muzzle, broad hanging ears, a deep chest, and long straight legs.
Staffordshire Bull Terrier: The Staffordshire Bull Terrier has a broad short head, pronounced cheek muscles, a short muzzle, folded rose-shaped ears, a broad chest, and a compact body with short smooth fur.
American Staffordshire Terrier: The American Staffordshire Terrier has a broad block-shaped head, a deep muzzle, a thick neck, a wide chest, pronounced shoulder contours, and a short close coat.
Bedlington Terrier: The Bedlington Terrier has a pear-shaped head with an arched tufted crown, narrow hanging ears with tasseled tips, a curly pale coat, and a curved back above a tucked waist.
Border Terrier: The Border Terrier has a broad flat skull, a short blunt muzzle, folded V-shaped ears, a wiry grizzled coat, and a straight tapering tail above a narrow torso.
Kerry Blue Terrier: The Kerry Blue Terrier has a dense wavy blue-gray coat, a long rectangular head, a full beard, folded V-shaped ears, long straight legs, and a short upright tail.
Irish Terrier: The Irish Terrier has a wiry red coat, a long narrow rectangular head, a short beard, forward-folded V-shaped ears, long straight legs, and a high-set tail.
Norfolk Terrier: The Norfolk Terrier has a low compact body, a coarse red or black-and-tan coat, folded ears close to the cheeks, a short bearded muzzle, and short legs.
Norwich Terrier: The Norwich Terrier has a low compact body, pointed upright ears, a short bearded muzzle, a wiry red or black-and-tan coat, and short straight legs.
Yorkshire Terrier: The Yorkshire Terrier has a long straight coat, steel-blue hair across the back, tan hair on the head and legs, a fine muzzle, and small upright V-shaped ears.
Wire Fox Terrier: The Wire Fox Terrier has a predominantly white wiry coat with dark patches, a long rectangular bearded muzzle, folded V-shaped ears, straight legs, and an upright tail.
Lakeland Terrier: The Lakeland Terrier has a narrow rectangular head, a short beard, folded V-shaped ears, a square outline, straight legs, and a wiry coat that may include a dark saddle.
Sealyham Terrier: The Sealyham Terrier has an elongated low body, short legs, a predominantly white wiry coat, a broad head, dense eyebrows, a full beard, and folded ears.
Airedale Terrier: The Airedale Terrier has a tan head and legs, a dark saddle across the back, a wiry coat, a long bearded muzzle, folded V-shaped ears, and long straight legs.
Cairn Terrier: The Cairn Terrier has a compact shaggy body, upright pointed ears, a short broad muzzle, dark eyes beneath bushy brows, and a short thickly coated tail.
Australian Terrier: The Australian Terrier has an elongated low body, upright pointed ears, a shaggy neck ruff, a fine-haired head tuft, and a coarse blue-and-tan or red coat.
Dandie Dinmont Terrier: The Dandie Dinmont Terrier has a long low body, short legs, a broad head with a rounded pale hair tuft, hanging ears, and a curved tail above a pepper or mustard coat.
Boston Terrier: The Boston Terrier has a broad square head, a short flat muzzle, upright pointed ears, a short tail, and a smooth dark coat with white muzzle, chest, and facial blaze.
Miniature Schnauzer: The Miniature Schnauzer has a compact square body, a rectangular bearded muzzle, bushy eyebrows, a wiry gray or black coat, and longer hair along its straight legs.
Giant Schnauzer: The Giant Schnauzer has a deep broad chest, a rectangular head with dense eyebrows and a full beard, long straight legs, and a dense black or salt-and-pepper coat.
Standard Schnauzer: The Standard Schnauzer has a square torso, a level back, an elongated blunt muzzle with a beard, arched bushy eyebrows, and a wiry salt-and-pepper or black coat.
Scottish Terrier: The Scottish Terrier has a long rectangular head, upright pointed ears, dense eyebrows and beard, a low deep body, short legs, and a straight upright tail.
Tibetan Terrier: The Tibetan Terrier has a square body, a long shaggy coat covering the eyes and hanging ears, broad rounded paws, and a feathered tail curled over its back.
Australian Silky Terrier: The Australian Silky Terrier has an elongated body, a straight blue-and-tan coat parted along the back, upright pointed ears, a tapered muzzle, and visible lower legs and feet.
Soft-coated Wheaten Terrier: The Soft-coated Wheaten Terrier has a wheat-colored wavy coat, a rectangular bearded muzzle, folded ears, a square torso, and long hair framing its dark eyes.
West Highland White Terrier: The West Highland White Terrier has a white shaggy coat, a rounded hairy face, upright triangular ears, dark eyes and nose, short legs, and a straight carrot-shaped tail.
Lhasa Apso: The Lhasa Apso has an elongated low body, a long straight coat parted along the spine, hair covering its hanging ears and eyes, and a plumed tail over its back.
Flat-Coated Retriever: The Flat-Coated Retriever has a long straight black or dark brown coat, a long narrow head, hanging ears, feathering along the legs, and a straight feathered tail.
Curly-coated Retriever: The Curly-coated Retriever has tightly curled black or dark brown fur across its body, a comparatively smooth face, hanging ears, a long wedge-shaped head, and a straight tapered tail.
Golden Retriever: The Golden Retriever has a golden or cream coat, a broad muzzle, hanging ears, a deep chest, and long feathering along the legs, underside, and tail.
Labrador Retriever: The Labrador Retriever has a short dense black, yellow, or brown coat, a broad head, hanging ears, a deep torso, and a thick straight tail tapering to a rounded tip.
Chesapeake Bay Retriever: The Chesapeake Bay Retriever has a brown or straw-colored coat with waves across the shoulders and back, pale amber eyes, hanging ears, and a broad tapered muzzle.
German Shorthaired Pointer: The German Shorthaired Pointer has a close brown or brown-and-white coat with ticking or patches, a long muzzle, broad hanging ears, a deep chest, and long straight legs.
Vizsla: The Vizsla has a short rust-gold coat, a brown nose, long rounded hanging ears, a tapered muzzle, a deep narrow chest, and long slender legs.
English Setter: The English Setter has a white coat with fine dark or orange speckles, long feathered hanging ears, a narrow muzzle, and feathering along the legs and tail.
Irish Setter: The Irish Setter has a chestnut-red coat, long feathered hanging ears, a narrow elongated head, a deep chest, and long straight hair along the underside and tail.
Gordon Setter: The Gordon Setter has a black coat with tan eyebrows, muzzle, chest, and lower legs, long feathered ears, a deep head, and a feathered tapered tail.
Brittany dog: The Brittany dog has a compact square body, an orange-and-white or brown-and-white coat, short high-set hanging ears, a tapered muzzle, and light feathering behind the legs.
Clumber Spaniel: The Clumber Spaniel has a long low broad body, a broad square head, drooping lips, hanging ears, and a dense white coat with lemon or orange head patches.
English Springer Spaniel: The English Springer Spaniel has a white coat with black or dark brown patches, long hanging ears, a broad muzzle, and feathering along the chest, legs, and underside.
Welsh Springer Spaniel: The Welsh Springer Spaniel has a red-and-white coat, rounded hanging ears, a tapered head, a rectangular body, and fine feathering along the legs, chest, and tail.
Cocker Spaniel: The Cocker Spaniel has a rounded head, broad muzzle, large dark eyes, long feathered hanging ears, and a dense coat with long hair along the legs and underside.
Sussex Spaniel: The Sussex Spaniel has a long low body, a golden-brown wavy coat, a broad head, broad hanging ears, short thick legs, and feathering along the chest and underside.
Irish Water Spaniel: The Irish Water Spaniel has a dark brown curly coat, a curled head tuft, long hair-covered ears, a smooth narrow face, and a tapering tail mostly free of long hair.
Kuvasz: The Kuvasz has a white wavy coat, a wedge-shaped head, dark almond-shaped eyes, V-shaped hanging ears, long straight legs, and a feathered tail with an upturned tip.
Schipperke: The Schipperke has a dense black coat, upright triangular ears, a pointed muzzle, a thick neck ruff, and a compact body with a back sloping gently toward the rump.
Groenendael dog: The Groenendael dog has a long black coat, a thick neck ruff, upright triangular ears, a narrow pointed muzzle, a square torso, and a long feathered tail.
Malinois: The Malinois has a short fawn coat with dark-tipped hairs, a black facial mask, upright dark triangular ears, a narrow head, and a lean square body.
Briard: The Briard has a long wavy coat, hair falling over the eyes, a broad bearded muzzle, an elongated torso, and a long feathered tail with a hooked tip.
Australian Kelpie: The Australian Kelpie has a short black, brown, or red coat, upright triangular ears, a tapered muzzle, a lean rectangular torso, and a low brush-shaped tail.
Komondor: The Komondor has long cream-white rope-shaped coat cords covering its body, face, and hanging ears, with thick column-like legs and a low tail partly concealed by cords.
Old English Sheepdog: The Old English Sheepdog has a dense shaggy gray-and-white coat, a white head and chest, hair covering the eyes, a broad torso, and thickly coated legs.
Shetland Sheepdog: The Shetland Sheepdog has a long sable, tricolor, or mottled gray coat, a white neck ruff, a narrow wedge-shaped face, tipped upright ears, and a feathered tail.
collie: The collie has an elongated tapered head, a smooth narrow muzzle, almond-shaped eyes, forward-tipped ears, a long full coat with a neck ruff, and a plumed tail.
Border Collie: The Border Collie has a tapered muzzle, widely spaced ears that may be erect or folded, a lean rectangular body, and often a white blaze, chest, and feet on a dark coat.
Bouvier des Flandres dog: The Bouvier des Flandres dog has a broad square body, a coarse shaggy gray, brindled, or black coat, a broad bearded muzzle, thick eyebrows, and thick straight legs.
Rottweiler: The Rottweiler has a broad head, a deep square muzzle, folded triangular ears, a thick neck, and a short black coat with tan eyebrows, cheeks, chest patches, and lower legs.
German Shepherd Dog: The German Shepherd Dog has upright triangular ears, an elongated dark muzzle, a long sloping torso, a dense black-and-tan or sable coat, and a low bushy tail.
Dobermann: The Dobermann has a close black or brown coat with rust-colored markings, a long wedge-shaped head, a narrow waist, a deep chest, and long straight legs.
Miniature Pinscher: The Miniature Pinscher has a short red or black-and-tan coat, a wedge-shaped head, high-set ears, a compact square body, a tucked waist, and fine straight legs.
Greater Swiss Mountain Dog: The Greater Swiss Mountain Dog has a broad head, hanging triangular ears, a short black coat with rust markings, a white facial blaze and chest, and a long thick tail.
Bernese Mountain Dog: The Bernese Mountain Dog has a long black coat, rust-colored eyebrows and cheeks, a white facial blaze and chest, hanging triangular ears, and a thick feathered tail.
Appenzeller Sennenhund: The Appenzeller Sennenhund has a short tricolor coat, a white facial blaze and chest, rust eyebrows and cheeks, folded triangular ears, and a tail curled tightly over its back.
Entlebucher Sennenhund: The Entlebucher Sennenhund has an elongated compact body, a short black coat with rust and white markings, folded triangular ears, a broad muzzle, and relatively short straight legs.
Boxer: The Boxer has a square body, a deep chest, a short broad black muzzle, an undershot lower jaw, and a smooth fawn or brindled coat, often with white chest markings.
Bullmastiff: The Bullmastiff has a broad wrinkled head, a short black muzzle, dark folded ears, a thick neck, and a broad deep body covered in short fawn, red, or brindled fur.
Tibetan Mastiff: The Tibetan Mastiff has a broad head, hanging ears, a dense mane-like neck ruff, a thick black, brown, or gold coat, and a heavily feathered tail curled over its back.
French Bulldog: The French Bulldog has a broad square head, a short wrinkled muzzle, large upright round-tipped ears, a compact deep body, short legs, and a short tail.
Great Dane: The Great Dane has a long rectangular head, a deep muzzle with hanging lips, a long neck, a deep chest, long straight legs, and a close smooth coat.
St. Bernard: The St. Bernard has a broad head, a deep muzzle with hanging lips, folded ears, and a broad white-and-reddish-brown body, often with a dark mask around the eyes.
husky: The husky has a dense coat, upright triangular ears, a wedge-shaped muzzle, a bushy curved tail, and often a pale face bordered by darker forehead and cheek markings.
Alaskan Malamute: The Alaskan Malamute has a broad head, widely spaced triangular ears, a thick gray-and-white or dark-and-white coat, a broad chest, and a heavily plumed tail over its back.
Siberian Husky: The Siberian Husky has a tapered muzzle, upright triangular ears, a dense coat with contrasting facial markings, almond-shaped eyes, and a bushy sickle-shaped tail above a lean torso.
Dalmatian: The Dalmatian has a short white coat covered with separate round black or dark brown spots, a long muzzle, spotted hanging ears, straight legs, and a slender tapering tail.
Affenpinscher: The Affenpinscher has a short blunt muzzle, round dark eyes, a projecting lower jaw, coarse dark fur, and longer hair forming bushy eyebrows, a beard, and a cheek ruff.
Basenji: The Basenji has a short close coat, a wrinkled forehead, upright pointed ears, a narrow muzzle, a white chest and feet, and a tightly curled tail.
pug: The pug has a round wrinkled face, a short dark muzzle, prominent round eyes, folded ears, a compact square body, and a tightly curled tail.
Leonberger: The Leonberger has a long tawny or reddish-brown coat, a black facial mask, hanging ears, a broad muzzle, a thick neck ruff, and a long bushy tail.
Newfoundland dog: The Newfoundland dog has a broad head, a deep blunt muzzle, hanging ears, a broad deep body, and a dense long black, brown, or black-and-white coat.
Great Pyrenees dog: The Great Pyrenees dog has a thick predominantly white coat, a broad wedge-shaped head, dark almond-shaped eyes, hanging triangular ears, a neck ruff, and a long plumed tail.
Samoyed: The Samoyed has a dense white or cream coat, a broad neck ruff, upright triangular ears, dark almond-shaped eyes, a black nose, and a plumed tail curled over its back.
Pomeranian: The Pomeranian has a rounded outline formed by abundant fur, a thick chest ruff, a short pointed muzzle, small upright ears, and a heavily plumed tail over its back.
Chow Chow: The Chow Chow has a broad flat muzzle, small rounded upright ears, a thick mane-like ruff, straight-looking hind legs, and a curled tail above a square densely coated body.
Keeshond: The Keeshond has a dense gray-and-black coat, a pale neck ruff, dark lines around the eyes resembling spectacles, upright pointed ears, and a plumed tail curled over its back.
brussels griffon: The Brussels Griffon has a rounded head, very short upturned muzzle, prominent dark eyes, a projecting lower jaw, and often coarse fur forming a beard around its face.
Pembroke Welsh Corgi: The Pembroke Welsh Corgi has a long low body, short legs, upright pointed ears, a fox-shaped muzzle, a dense red or tricolor coat, and often a short visible tail.
Cardigan Welsh Corgi: The Cardigan Welsh Corgi has a long low body, short slightly bowed forelegs, large round-tipped upright ears, a broad muzzle, and a long bushy tail.
Toy Poodle: The Toy Poodle has dense curls, a narrow straight muzzle, dark oval eyes, hanging hair-covered ears, a square body outline, and a high-set tail.
Miniature Poodle: The Miniature Poodle has a square torso, a dense curly coat, a long straight muzzle, hanging ears close to the head, dark oval eyes, and straight legs.
Standard Poodle: The Standard Poodle has a dense curled coat, a long straight muzzle, hanging ears, an arched neck, a deep chest, a square torso, and a high-set tail.
Mexican hairless dog (xoloitzcuintli): The Mexican hairless dog has largely bare gray, black, or copper-colored skin, a long tapered muzzle, large upright ears, slender legs, and sometimes a short tuft on the crown.
grey wolf: The grey wolf has a long broad muzzle, upright triangular ears, dense gray-brown fur with pale cheek markings, long legs, broad paws, and a straight bushy tail.
Alaskan tundra wolf: The Alaskan tundra wolf has a thick pale gray or cream coat, a broad neck ruff, a long blunt muzzle, compact triangular ears, broad paws, and a densely furred tail.
red wolf or maned wolf: The red wolf or maned wolf has a lean, long-legged body, an elongated muzzle, upright pointed ears, and reddish-brown fur with darker gray-brown across the back.
coyote: The coyote has a narrow pointed muzzle, relatively large upright ears, a gray-brown coat, pale throat, slender legs, and a bushy tail with a dark tip.
dingo: The dingo has a short sandy or reddish coat, a wedge-shaped head, upright triangular ears, a pale muzzle and underside, and a bushy tail, often with a pale tip.
dhole: The dhole has a reddish-brown coat, a pale throat and chest, a broad short muzzle, rounded upright ears, and a bushy tail with a dark tip.
African wild dog: The African wild dog has broad rounded ears, a narrow dark muzzle, long slender legs, irregular black, tan, and white coat patches, and a white-tipped bushy tail.
hyena: The hyena has a deep chest, a thick neck, a broad dark muzzle, rounded or pointed ears, and a back sloping toward shorter hindquarters, with spotted or striped fur.
red fox: The red fox has a pointed muzzle, upright triangular ears with dark backs, reddish fur, dark lower legs, a pale chest, and a bushy white-tipped tail.
kit fox: The kit fox has very large upright ears, a narrow pointed muzzle, pale tan-gray fur, a white underside, slender legs, and a bushy tail with a dark tip.
Arctic fox: The Arctic fox has a compact rounded body, short rounded ears, a short muzzle, thick white or gray-brown fur, densely furred feet, and a broad bushy tail.
grey fox: The grey fox has grizzled gray upperparts, reddish-brown flanks and legs, a pale throat, a pointed muzzle, and a bushy tail with a black upper stripe and tip.
tabby cat: The tabby cat has a patterned coat with dark stripes, spots, or curved swirls, an M-shaped forehead marking, facial stripes, and dark rings around the legs and tail.
tiger cat: The tiger cat has a short feline muzzle, upright triangular ears, and a coat marked by narrow dark vertical flank stripes, a dark back stripe, and ringed legs and tail.
Persian cat: The Persian cat has a broad flattened face, a short upturned nose, round eyes, small widely spaced ears, a dense long coat, short legs, and a thickly furred tail.
Siamese cat: The Siamese cat has blue almond-shaped eyes, a wedge-shaped head, large pointed ears, a slender body, and a short pale coat with dark face, ears, legs, and tail.
Egyptian Mau: The Egyptian Mau has a short silver, bronze, or dark coat with separate dark spots, a striped face, green eyes, ringed tail, and elongated hind legs.
cougar: The cougar has a plain tawny coat, a pale muzzle and underside, rounded dark-backed ears, a compact rounded head, and a long cylindrical tail with a dark tip.
lynx: The lynx has pointed black ear tufts, broad cheek ruffs, a short black-tipped tail, long legs, broad furry paws, and mottled or spotted gray-brown fur.
leopard: The leopard has a golden coat with dark rosettes, solid spots on the head and legs, a pale belly, a rounded head, and a long spotted tail.
snow leopard: The snow leopard has pale gray fur with dark open rosettes, a broad rounded face, small rounded ears, thickly furred paws, and an elongated thick tail.
jaguar: The jaguar has a stocky body, a broad square muzzle, and a yellow-gold coat with large dark rosettes, many containing central spots, plus a comparatively short thick tail.
lion: The lion has a plain tawny coat, a broad muzzle, rounded ears, and a long tail ending in a dark tuft; some individuals have a dense head and neck mane.
tiger: The tiger has an orange coat crossed by irregular black stripes, white cheeks and underside, rounded black-backed ears with white spots, and a thick ringed tail.
cheetah: The cheetah has a slender long-legged body, a narrow waist, round black spots on tan fur, black tear-shaped facial stripes, and a long tail with dark rings near its tip.
brown bear: The brown bear has shaggy brown fur, a prominent shoulder hump, a concave facial profile, rounded ears, thick legs, and long curved claws.
American black bear: The American black bear has a straight facial profile, rounded upright ears, a pale brown muzzle, dense black or brown fur, and a back without a prominent shoulder hump.
polar bear: The polar bear has cream-white fur, a long narrow head, a black nose, small rounded ears, an elongated neck, broad furry paws, and a short tail.
sloth bear: The sloth bear has a shaggy black coat, a pale elongated muzzle, a pale V-shaped chest patch, rounded furry ears, and long pale curved claws.
mongoose: The mongoose has an elongated low body, a pointed muzzle, small rounded ears, short legs, grizzled brown-gray fur, and a long tapering furry tail.
meerkat: The meerkat has a slender tan body, dark eye patches, a pointed muzzle, small rounded ears, dark horizontal back bands, and a thin tail with a dark tip.
tiger beetle: The tiger beetle has a narrow body, prominent rounded eyes, curved projecting jaws, long slender legs, threadlike antennae, and often reflective wing covers with pale spots or bands.
ladybug: The ladybug has a rounded domed body, paired smooth wing covers with a central seam, short antennae, and contrasting spots on red, orange, yellow, or black surfaces.
ground beetle: The ground beetle has an elongated flattened oval body, a narrower thorax, long threadlike antennae, angular legs, and dark wing covers often marked with parallel lengthwise grooves.
longhorn beetle: The longhorn beetle has an elongated body, narrow wing covers, six jointed legs, and segmented antennae that extend to or beyond the length of the body.
leaf beetle: The leaf beetle has a compact oval domed body, short to moderately long antennae, and closely fitted wing covers, often with reflective green, blue, red, or striped coloration.
dung beetle: The dung beetle has a thick oval domed body, a broad shield-shaped head, ridged wing covers, short clubbed antennae, and flattened front legs with toothed outer edges.
rhinoceros beetle: The rhinoceros beetle has a thick glossy oval body, broad wing covers, thick toothed legs, and often one or more curved horn-like projections on the head or thorax.
weevil: The weevil has an oval body with textured wing covers, an elongated projecting snout, elbowed antennae attached to the snout, and six short angular legs.
fly: The fly has a compact body, a broad head dominated by large compound eyes, short antennae, six slender legs, and one pair of transparent veined wings.
bee: The bee has a densely hairy thorax, a segmented abdomen often banded in black and yellow, elbowed antennae, six legs, and two pairs of translucent wings.
ant: The ant has a broad head, elbowed antennae, six slender jointed legs, and a rounded abdomen connected to the thorax by a narrow waist with one or two nodes.
grasshopper: The grasshopper has an elongated body, short antennae, folded side wings, and enlarged bent hind legs with thick upper segments and long spiny lower segments.
cricket insect: The cricket insect has long threadlike antennae, a rounded head, a cylindrical brown or black body, enlarged bent hind legs, and two slender projections at the rear.
stick insect: The stick insect has an elongated cylindrical body, a narrow head, long antennae, and six thin jointed legs resembling the proportions and angular outlines of twigs.
cockroach: The cockroach has a flattened oval brown body, a shield-like plate partly covering the head, long threadlike antennae, overlapping wing covers, and six spiny legs.
praying mantis: The praying mantis has a triangular head with prominent eyes, a long narrow thorax, and folded front legs with thick spiny inner edges beneath an elongated body.
cicada: The cicada has a broad blunt head, widely spaced eyes, short antennae, a thick tapered abdomen, and transparent wings with prominent veins extending beyond the body.
leafhopper: The leafhopper has a wedge-shaped body, a broad head, roof-shaped folded wings tapering toward the rear, and rows of visible spines along the hind legs.
lacewing: The lacewing has a slender green or brown body, long threadlike antennae, rounded reflective eyes, and four translucent wings covered by a dense network of fine veins.
dragonfly: The dragonfly has a long segmented abdomen, large eyes occupying most of the head, short antennae, and four transparent veined wings with broad bases.
damselfly: The damselfly has a threadlike segmented abdomen, widely separated rounded eyes, short antennae, and four narrow transparent wings with slender stalk-like bases.
red admiral butterfly: The red admiral butterfly has dark wings crossed by orange-red bands, white spots near the forewing tips, and an orange-red border along the hindwings.
ringlet butterfly: The ringlet butterfly has rounded brown wings, pale fringed edges, and rows of circular dark eyespots surrounded by pale yellow rings on the wing undersides.
monarch butterfly: The monarch butterfly has orange wings divided by black veins, broad black borders containing white spots, and a black body marked with small white dots.
small white butterfly: The small white butterfly has white upper wings with gray-black forewing tips and one or two dark forewing spots, plus pale yellow-green hindwing undersides.
sulphur butterfly: The sulphur butterfly has rounded yellow, orange, or pale cream wings, often with dark outer borders, a dark forewing spot, and a pale ringed spot beneath each hindwing.
gossamer-winged butterfly: The gossamer-winged butterfly has rounded blue, copper, or brown wings with fine fringes, slender clubbed antennae, and often rows of dark spots on pale wing undersides.
starfish: The starfish has a central disc with broad tapering arms arranged radially, usually five, and an upper surface covered with small bumps, plates, or short spines.
sea urchin: The sea urchin has a rounded or flattened spherical body densely covered with pointed spines radiating outward, often interspersed with finer threadlike projections.
sea cucumber: The sea cucumber has an elongated cylindrical body with rounded ends, a wrinkled or knobby surface, and rows of small projections along its length.
cottontail rabbit: The cottontail rabbit has mottled brown-gray fur, upright oval ears, a rounded body, long folded hind legs, and a short tail with a white underside.
hare: The hare has an elongated body, very long upright ears often tipped with black, long hind legs, a narrow face, and mottled brown-gray fur.
Angora rabbit: The Angora rabbit has a rounded body almost concealed by very long abundant fur, upright ears often bearing hair tufts, a short muzzle, and a short densely furred tail.
hamster: The hamster has a rounded body, short legs, rounded ears, prominent dark eyes, a blunt whiskered muzzle, and a short tail barely extending beyond the fur.
porcupine: The porcupine has a rounded or elongated body covered with long pointed quills, a blunt muzzle, short legs, and quills that may form contrasting pale and dark bands.
fox squirrel: The fox squirrel has grizzled gray-brown upperparts, orange or rusty underparts, rounded ears, a broad bushy tail, and elongated rear feet beneath a compact torso.
marmot: The marmot has a stocky low body, dense grizzled brown fur, short rounded ears, a broad blunt muzzle, short legs, and a thick furry tail.
beaver: The beaver has a rounded brown-furred body, a blunt head, small rounded ears, webbed hind feet, and a broad flat dark tail with a scaly surface.
guinea pig: The guinea pig has a rounded barrel-shaped body, a blunt muzzle, folded rounded ears, short legs, and no visible tail, with solid or patchy fur.
common sorrel horse: The common sorrel horse has a reddish-brown coat, a matching or lighter mane and tail, a long narrow head, upright ears, long legs, and single rounded hooves.
zebra: The zebra has a horse-shaped body covered with black and white stripes, an upright striped mane, rounded upright ears, and a slender tail ending in a dark tuft.
pig: The pig has a barrel-shaped body, a broad round-ended snout with two nostrils, triangular ears, short legs with split hooves, and a thin straight or curled tail.
wild boar: The wild boar has a wedge-shaped head, a long blunt snout, a coarse dark bristled coat, a raised shoulder outline, and curved tusks projecting beside the mouth.
warthog: The warthog has a broad flattened head, rounded facial projections, upward-curved tusks, sparsely haired gray skin, a long back mane, and a thin tufted tail.
hippopotamus: The hippopotamus has a barrel-shaped nearly hairless gray body, a broad rectangular muzzle, eyes and rounded ears high on the head, and short thick legs.
ox: The ox has a broad bovine head, a wide muzzle, a thick neck, a deep barrel-shaped torso, split hooves, and a long tufted tail, often with paired curved horns.
water buffalo: The water buffalo has dark sparsely haired skin, a broad muzzle, widely spreading crescent-shaped horns, a deep chest, thick legs, and a long thin tail with a tuft.
bison: The bison has a high shoulder hump, a broad shaggy head and forequarters, short curved horns, a beard, and comparatively short-haired hindquarters beneath a sloping back.
ram (adult male sheep): The ram has a thick curled wool coat, a broad muzzle, lateral ears, split hooves, and paired ridged horns that curve outward and around the sides of the head.
bighorn sheep: The bighorn sheep has a short brown coat, a white rump patch, a pale muzzle, split hooves, and thick ridged horns curling beside the face in many individuals.
Alpine ibex: The Alpine ibex has a brown-gray coat, a narrow beard, short tail, split hooves, and long backward-curving horns with prominent transverse ridges along their front edges.
hartebeest: The hartebeest has an elongated narrow face, high shoulders, a sloping back, reddish-brown fur, and paired ridged horns with angular outward and backward bends.
impala (antelope): The impala has a reddish-brown back, white underside, slender legs, dark rump stripes, and often long ridged horns with outward curves and inward-pointing tips.
gazelle: The gazelle has a slender tan body, a pale belly, dark facial stripes, long thin legs, and often ringed horns with gentle backward curves.
arabian camel: The Arabian camel has one prominent back hump, a long curved neck, tan fur, an elongated split upper lip, long legs, and broad two-toed feet.
llama: The llama has a long upright neck, an elongated muzzle, curved pointed ears, a thick shaggy coat, slender legs, and a short furry tail.
weasel: The weasel has an elongated narrow body, short legs, a pointed muzzle, small rounded ears, brown upperparts, a pale underside, and a slender furry tail.
mink: The mink has an elongated dark brown body, a narrow head, small rounded ears, short legs, and a densely furred tapering tail, often with a white chin patch.
European polecat: The European polecat has an elongated dark brown body, pale fur across the muzzle and ear rims, a dark mask around the eyes, short legs, and a bushy tail.
black-footed ferret: The black-footed ferret has a slender cream-colored body, a broad black eye mask, black lower legs and feet, rounded ears, and a tail with a black tip.
otter: The otter has an elongated brown body, a rounded head, a broad whiskered muzzle, small rounded ears, short webbed feet, and a thick tail tapering smoothly from its base.
skunk: The skunk has a low black-furred body, contrasting white stripes or patches, a pointed muzzle, short legs, and a long bushy tail with white markings.
badger: The badger has a broad flattened body, coarse gray fur, a pale head with dark facial stripes, short black legs, a short tail, and long curved front claws.
armadillo: The armadillo has a domed shell of rectangular plates and transverse bands, a pointed snout, prominent upright ears, short clawed legs, and a long ringed tapering tail.
three-toed sloth: The three-toed sloth has shaggy gray-brown fur, a rounded head with dark eye stripes, long forelimbs, a short tail, and three elongated curved claws on each forefoot.
orangutan: The orangutan has long reddish-brown hair, arms longer than its legs, a broad dark face, long curved fingers, and often wide rounded cheek pads.
gorilla: The gorilla has a broad chest, thick dark fur, long thick arms, a broad bare face, a flattened nose with wide nostrils, and a prominent brow ridge.
chimpanzee: The chimpanzee has black body hair, a largely bare face, projecting rounded ears, a pronounced muzzle, arms longer than its legs, and no external tail.
gibbon: The gibbon has a slender tailless body, very long arms, long fingers, a small rounded head, and black, brown, or pale fur, often framing a dark face.
siamang: The siamang has a tailless body with shaggy black fur, very long arms, a rounded dark face, and a prominent bare gray-black pouch beneath the chin.
guenon: The guenon has a slender long-tailed body, a rounded short-muzzled face, dense grizzled fur, and contrasting eyebrow, nose, or cheek patches around dark eyes.
patas monkey: The patas monkey has reddish-brown upperparts, pale underparts and lower legs, long slender limbs, a dark face bordered by pale whiskers, and a long narrow tail.
baboon: The baboon has an elongated dog-shaped muzzle, close-set eyes beneath a brow ridge, a thick body coat, long limbs, and a curved tail with a downward-hanging tip.
macaque: The macaque has a compact torso, gray or brown fur, a mostly bare pink or brown face, a short projecting muzzle, rounded ears, and stocky limbs.
langur: The langur has a slender body, long limbs, a very long tail, and a dark face framed by pale or gray fur, often with a pointed crown tuft.
black-and-white colobus: The black-and-white colobus has a black face and body, long white hair framing the face and shoulders, pale side fringes, and a long tail with a white tuft.
proboscis monkey: The proboscis monkey has reddish-brown upperparts, a pale belly, a long tail, and a projecting fleshy nose that may form a broad pendulous lobe above the mouth.
marmoset: The marmoset has a compact furry body, a short muzzle, large eyes, ear tufts in many forms, and a long tail often marked with alternating dark and pale rings.
white-headed capuchin: The white-headed capuchin has a pale cream face, neck, and shoulders, a dark crown and body, a rounded bare facial area, and a long dark curved tail.
howler monkey: The howler monkey has a thick furred body, a broad jaw, a deep throat and neck profile, a bare dark face, and a long thick tail.
titi monkey: The titi monkey has dense brown, gray, or reddish fur, a rounded face surrounded by cheek hair, short rounded ears, and a long cylindrical furry tail.
Geoffroy's spider monkey: Geoffroy's spider monkey has very long slender limbs, a long curved tail, a dark face with pale eye surrounds, and tan or reddish body fur with darker hands and feet.
common squirrel monkey: The common squirrel monkey has a white mask around the eyes, a dark muzzle, an olive-gray back, yellow-orange limbs, and a long narrow tail with a dark tip.
ring-tailed lemur: The ring-tailed lemur has a gray body, a white face with dark eye patches, a pointed dark muzzle, and a long bushy tail banded in black and white.
indri: The indri has dense black-and-white fur, a dark face, broad furry rounded ears, long hind legs, and a very short tail barely visible behind its body.
Asian elephant: The Asian elephant has gray wrinkled skin, a twin-domed forehead, relatively compact rounded ears, a convex back, and a long trunk with one finger-like upper tip.
African bush elephant: The African bush elephant has gray wrinkled skin, broad fan-shaped ears, a concave back, a long trunk with two opposing tip projections, and often paired curved tusks.
red panda: The red panda has reddish-brown fur, white facial markings, dark legs and underside, pointed pale-rimmed ears, and a long bushy tail with alternating reddish and pale rings.
giant panda: The giant panda has a white head with black eye patches and rounded black ears, a white torso, black shoulders and legs, and a short tail.
snoek fish: The snoek fish has an elongated silver body, a dark blue-gray back, a long pointed head, visible pointed teeth, a deeply forked tail, and small finlets near the tail.
eel: The eel has an elongated cylindrical body tapering toward the tail, a narrow head, and a long fin border along the back and underside, with no visible pelvic fins.
silver salmon: The silver salmon has a silver-sided streamlined body, a blue-green back with dark spots, a small fleshy fin behind the dorsal fin, and dark spots mainly on the upper tail lobe.
rock beauty fish: The rock beauty fish has a deep flattened oval body, a yellow head and tail, a broad black patch covering most of the body, and blue accents near the eyes.
clownfish: The clownfish has an orange oval body crossed by broad white bands outlined in black, rounded fins with dark edges, and a short rounded tail.
sturgeon: The sturgeon has an elongated body with rows of raised plates, a pointed snout, hanging barbels beneath the snout, and a tail with a longer upper lobe.
gar fish: The gar fish has a long cylindrical body, an elongated narrow toothed snout, diamond-patterned scales, and dorsal and anal fins positioned close to the rounded tail.
lionfish: The lionfish has alternating pale and reddish-brown stripes, long separated dorsal spines, broad fan-shaped pectoral fins, and fleshy projections above the eyes and around the mouth.
pufferfish: The pufferfish has a rounded or elongated swollen-looking body, prominent eyes, a short beak-like mouth, short fins, and often visible surface spines or dark spots.
abacus: The abacus has a rectangular frame containing parallel rods, rows of separate beads on the rods, and often a crossbar dividing each rod into unequal sections.
abaya: The abaya is a loose full-length robe with long sleeves, a broad draped silhouette, and a straight or open front, often formed from plain dark fabric.
academic gown: The academic gown has a long loose body, broad hanging sleeves, an open or pleated front, and a gathered shoulder yoke, sometimes with contrasting vertical trim.
accordion: The accordion has two box-shaped end panels joined by pleated bellows, a piano-style keyboard or button rows on one side, and additional buttons on the other.
acoustic guitar: The acoustic guitar has a waisted body, a circular opening below the strings, a long fretted neck, six strings stretched over a bridge, and a headstock with tuning pegs.
aircraft carrier: The aircraft carrier has a broad flat rectangular upper deck, runway-like lines, aircraft on the deck in many views, and a tower structure offset to one side.
airliner: The airliner has an elongated cylindrical fuselage, rows of oval windows, swept wings, cylindrical engine nacelles, and an upright tail fin with horizontal stabilizers.
airship: The airship has an elongated rounded envelope, a pointed or tapered rear end, tail fins, and a compact suspended gondola beneath the main body.
altar: The altar has a raised rectangular table or block, a broad flat top, and a decorated front, often with a cloth, candles, flowers, or a cross above it.
ambulance: The ambulance has a van-like or box-bodied vehicle silhouette, prominent colored stripes, roof-mounted light bars, medical cross or star emblems, and often the word AMBULANCE on its panels.
amphibious vehicle: The amphibious vehicle has a boat-shaped lower body with raised sides, visible road wheels beneath the hull, a windshield or open cabin, and a sloped bow-like front.
analog clock: The analog clock has a round or angular face with evenly spaced numerals or tick marks and two or three narrow hands meeting at a central pivot.
apiary: The apiary contains multiple box-shaped hives arranged in rows or groups, with stacked rectangular sections, flat or pitched lids, and narrow openings near their bases.
apron: The apron has a broad fabric front panel, an upper bib or waistband, neck or shoulder straps, and side ties, often with one or more patch pockets.
trash can: The trash can has a deep upright container body, a broad upper opening, and often a separate or hinged lid, side handles, or a foot pedal near the base.
assault rifle: The assault rifle has a long barrel, a box-shaped central body, a shoulder stock, a separate pistol grip, a trigger guard, and a projecting magazine, often curved.
backpack: The backpack has a fabric bag body with zippered compartments, two broad rear shoulder straps, a top loop handle, and often front or side pockets.
bakery: The bakery has counters, trays, or shelves displaying rows of bread loaves, rolls, cakes, and pastries, often behind glass-fronted display cases and a broad shop window.
balance beam: The balance beam has a long narrow rectangular top with a continuous flat surface, raised above the floor on two widely spaced pedestal or trestle supports.
balloon: The balloon has a bulbous envelope narrowing toward an open neck, curved vertical panel seams, and a basket suspended below by cables or struts.
ballpoint pen: The ballpoint pen has a slender cylindrical barrel, a narrow conical tip with a tiny dark point, and often a pocket clip, cap, or push button.
Band-Aid: The Band-Aid is a thin elongated strip with rounded ends, a pale central rectangular pad, and broad perforated or textured side tabs.
banjo: The banjo has a circular drum-like body with a pale flat face, a long fretted neck, strings over a short bridge, and tuning pegs along the headstock.
baluster / handrail: The baluster or handrail assembly has a continuous horizontal or sloping top rail above a row of upright posts, often with repeated turned, square, or carved profiles.
barbell: The barbell has a long straight cylindrical bar with stacks of circular discs at both ends, often secured by collars beside the disc stacks.
barber chair: The barber chair has a thick padded seat and back, armrests, a headrest, a projecting footrest, and a central pedestal on a broad circular or polygonal base.
barbershop: The barbershop has a row of padded pedestal chairs facing mirrors, narrow counters with bottles, combs, and scissors, and often a striped cylindrical pole near the entrance.
barn: The barn has a broad rectangular building body, a high pitched or gambrel roof, large double doors, and often vertical plank siding with a smaller opening above the doors.
barometer: The barometer has a round dial with a pointer and closely spaced numbered markings, often labeled with pressure units or weather words, within a circular or carved wall-mounted case.
barrel: The barrel has a cylindrical body bulging at the middle, circular flat ends, curved vertical staves, and several dark horizontal hoops around the body.
wheelbarrow: The wheelbarrow has an open sloped tray, one or two front wheels, two long handles projecting backward, and a pair of support legs beneath the tray.
baseball: The baseball is a white sphere with two curved seams outlined by repeated red V-shaped stitches across its lightly textured surface.
basketball: The basketball is a round orange-brown ball with a pebbled surface and dark recessed curved lines dividing it into broad elongated panels.
bassinet: The bassinet has an elongated oval or rectangular basket-shaped bed, raised fabric or woven sides, a shallow mattress, and often an arched hood above one end.
bassoon: The bassoon has a long reddish-brown body formed by adjacent tubes, numerous silver keys and rods, a flared upper opening, and a thin curved metal tube near the top.
swimming cap: The swimming cap is a close-fitting rounded cap with a smooth continuous surface, a curved lower edge around the forehead and ears, and slight folds near its rim.
bath towel: The bath towel is a rectangular sheet of densely looped fabric with hemmed edges, often with woven border bands and visible folds across its broad surface.
bathtub: The bathtub has an elongated deep basin with rounded corners, a wide raised rim, a visible drain opening, and often taps mounted along one end.
station wagon: The station wagon has a long roof extending over a rear cargo-shaped body section, multiple side windows, four side doors, and a near-vertical rear hatch.
lighthouse: The lighthouse has a tall narrow tower, a glazed lantern enclosure at the top, an exterior gallery railing, and often a contrasting striped or painted exterior.
beaker: The beaker has a cylindrical transparent body, a flat base, a wide open rim with a short pouring lip, and often numbered graduation lines on the side.
military hat (bearskin or shako): The military hat has a tall upright crown, either densely furred with a rounded top or cylindrical with a short visor, often with a badge, cord, or plume.
beer bottle: The beer bottle has a narrow neck, rounded shoulders, a cylindrical glass body, and a crown-style cap or ridged mouth, often with a printed paper label.
beer glass: The beer glass has a transparent open-topped body, a broad rim, and a thick base or handle, often containing amber liquid beneath a pale foam layer.
bell tower: The bell tower has a tall vertical structure with open arches or louvered openings near the top, visible suspended bells in some openings, and a roof or spire above.
baby bib: The baby bib has a rounded or rectangular fabric front panel, a semicircular neck opening, and two short upper straps with ties, snaps, or overlapping ends.
tandem bicycle: The tandem bicycle has an elongated frame with two saddles arranged one behind the other, two pedal sets, handlebars, and two aligned spoked wheels.
bikini: The bikini consists of a separate fitted top with two shaped front panels and straps, plus a matching bottom with a waistband and two leg openings.
ring binder: The ring binder has two flat rectangular covers joined by a thick spine, with a row of metal rings visible along the center when open.
binoculars: The binoculars have two parallel optical barrels connected by a central bridge, paired eyepieces, broad front lenses, and often a ridged focus wheel between the barrels.
birdhouse: The birdhouse has a box-shaped body, a roof, a circular entrance hole on the front, and often a short projecting peg beneath the hole.
boathouse: The boathouse has a roofed structure at the water's edge, broad open bays or doors facing the water, and often visible boats, docks, or supports beneath the floor.
bobsleigh: The bobsleigh has a long low rounded shell, a curved nose, an elongated open cockpit, and narrow metal runners visible beneath the body.
bolo tie: The bolo tie consists of a narrow looped cord passing through a broad patterned central clasp, with two cord ends hanging below and often capped by pointed metal tips.
poke bonnet: The poke bonnet has a rounded crown behind a deep forward-projecting brim that frames the face, with broad ribbons extending from the sides and often tied beneath the chin.
bookcase: The bookcase has an upright rectangular frame divided into horizontal shelves, with rows of book spines visible between vertical side panels.
bookstore: The bookstore has closely spaced shelves filled with books, display tables holding stacked or face-out volumes, and aisles or a counter within a shop interior.
bottle cap: The bottle cap has a flat circular top and a short raised rim, with crimped metal edges or a ridged cylindrical sidewall.
hunting bow: The hunting bow has two curved limbs joined by a central grip and a taut string between the tips, often with round cams, cable lines, and projecting attachments.
bow tie: The bow tie has two symmetrical folded fabric lobes spreading from a narrow central knot, with a thin neckband extending behind the bow.
brass memorial plaque: The brass memorial plaque is a flat gold-toned rectangular or shaped plate bearing engraved names or inscriptions, often with an engraved border and visible corner fasteners.
bra: The bra has two shaped cups connected at the center, narrow shoulder straps, and a horizontal band extending around the back, often with hooks or an adjustable clasp.
breakwater: The breakwater forms a long raised barrier extending across or into water, built from tightly arranged rocks, block-shaped units, or repeated angular concrete forms.
breastplate: The breastplate has a curved torso-shaped front panel, a raised chest contour, neck and arm cutouts, and often metal edging, rivets, or shoulder straps.
broom: The broom has a long straight handle attached to a dense bundle or rectangular row of bristles, with the bristle ends forming a broad flat or fan-shaped edge.
bucket: The bucket has a deep open cylindrical or tapered body, a flat base, a broad circular rim, and an arched handle attached on opposite sides.
buckle: The buckle has a rectangular, oval, or patterned frame with an opening and a central pin, bar, or interlocking clasp, often attached to a strap.
