bulletproof vest: The bulletproof vest has a thick sleeveless torso-shaped body, broad shoulder straps, overlapping rectangular panels, and visible side fasteners, webbing, or patch pockets.
high-speed train: The high-speed train has an elongated tapered nose, a curved windshield, smooth connected carriages, continuous rows of side windows, and dark wheel assemblies partly covered by lower panels.
butcher shop: The butcher shop has glass-fronted counters or hanging racks displaying red and pink meat cuts, broad work surfaces, and often visible hooks, knives, and printed price labels.
taxicab: The taxicab has a four-wheeled car body, a roof-mounted TAXI sign or visible taxi lettering, and often contrasting stripes, door numbers, or checkered side markings.
cauldron: The cauldron has a deep rounded dark body, a wide circular opening, a thick rim, side loops or an arched handle, and sometimes three short feet.
candle: The candle has a cylindrical, tapered, or molded wax body with a short wick protruding from its top, often surrounded by a shallow depression or uneven wax rim.
cannon: The cannon has a thick elongated barrel with a round opening, a wider rear section, and a supporting carriage or pedestal, often with two large side wheels.
canoe: The canoe has a long narrow open hull, pointed upward-curving ends, a continuous raised rim, and simple transverse seats or bars across the open center.
can opener: The can opener has paired handles connected to a compact head containing a toothed wheel and circular blade, often with a broad wing-shaped turning knob on one side.
cardigan: The cardigan has a knitted body, long sleeves, a full-length front opening, and a row of buttons or a zipper, often with ribbed cuffs and hem.
car mirror: The car mirror has a reflective oval or rectangular face within a thin casing, attached by a short arm to a windshield or a car's side panel.
carousel: The carousel has a circular raised platform, a broad decorated canopy, and rows of horse-shaped figures or seats attached to vertical poles beneath the canopy.
tool kit: The tool kit has a hinged or zippered case with fitted compartments containing differently shaped hand tools, such as pliers, sockets, screwdrivers, and wrenches.
cardboard box / carton: The cardboard box or carton has flat rectangular panels, folded corners, visible seams, and overlapping top flaps, often with brown paper surfaces and printed markings.
car wheel: The car wheel has a circular metal rim or hub with spokes or openings, surrounded by a thick black tire with patterned tread and molded sidewall lettering.
automated teller machine: The automated teller machine has a rectangular front panel with a screen, a numeric keypad, narrow horizontal slots, printed labels, and a recessed lower opening.
cassette: The cassette has a flat rectangular shell, two circular reel-hub openings, a narrow transparent window, and a row of small openings along one long edge.
cassette player: The cassette player has a rectangular body with a cassette-shaped compartment or window, a row of raised control buttons, and often speaker grilles or circular sockets.
castle: The castle has thick masonry walls, projecting towers, narrow windows, a large gate opening, and often crenellated parapets along the tops of walls and towers.
catamaran: The catamaran has two long parallel narrow hulls joined by a broad deck or crossbeams, with an open gap between the hulls and often a central mast.
CD player: The CD player has a round or rectangular body, a circular lid or disc-shaped recess, control buttons, and often a small numeric display or front loading tray.
cello: The cello has a tall waisted varnished body, two curved f-shaped openings, four strings, a long dark fingerboard, a scroll-shaped head, and a thin endpin below the base.
mobile phone: The mobile phone has a compact rectangular body, a flat display, and either a lower keypad or a broad screen, with speaker openings and small side buttons.
chain: The chain consists of repeated oval or round links passing through neighboring links, forming a continuous length with alternating link orientations and visible open centers.
chain-link fence: The chain-link fence has interwoven wires forming a repeated diamond mesh, stretched between upright posts and usually bordered by horizontal rails or tension wires.
chain mail: The chain mail has a dense sheet or garment surface made from interlocking metal rings, with repeated circular openings and overlapping rows following the draped outline.
chainsaw: The chainsaw has a bulky motor housing, a loop-shaped front handle, a rear handle, and a long flat bar bordered by a chain of pointed teeth.
storage chest: The storage chest has a broad rectangular box body, a hinged top lid, and often front latches, corner bands, or side handles, with a continuous front panel.
chiffonier: The chiffonier has a tall narrow cabinet body, several stacked drawers with paired knobs or handles, a flat top, and short feet or a solid base.
bell or wind chime: The bell or wind chime has one or more suspended flared cups or narrow tubes, a top loop or hanging frame, and often a central hanging rod or flat pendant.
china cabinet: The china cabinet has a tall framed body, glass-fronted upper doors, horizontal display shelves, and often solid lower cupboards, with plates, cups, or bowls visible behind the glass.
Christmas stocking: The Christmas stocking has a broad sock-shaped fabric body, a projecting rounded foot, a broad contrasting cuff, and a hanging loop, often with contrasting stitched motifs.
church: The church has a building facade with an arched entrance, tall windows, a pitched roof, and often a steeple, bell tower, cross, or colored glass panels.
movie theater: The movie theater interior has repeated rows of padded seats facing a broad rectangular screen, with aisles between seating blocks and often curtains framing the screen.
cleaver: The cleaver has a broad rectangular metal blade with a straight lower edge, a thick spine, and a short handle attached along one upper corner.
cliff dwelling: The cliff dwelling has closely grouped masonry rooms set beneath a rock overhang or within a cliff recess, with small rectangular openings and walls matching the surrounding stone.
cloak: The cloak has a broad sleeveless fabric body draped from the shoulders, a long curved hem, a front opening, and often a hood or neck clasp.
clogs: The clogs have rounded enclosed toes, thick raised soles, broad uppers, and open or low heels, often with visible wooden grain or a molded continuous shell.
cocktail shaker: The cocktail shaker has a tapered cylindrical body, a fitted domed or conical lid, and often a smaller cap on top, with visible circular seams between sections.
coffee mug: The coffee mug has a deep cylindrical or slightly tapered body, an open circular rim, a flat base, and a single curved loop handle on one side.
coffeemaker: The coffeemaker has an upright housing with a broad upper section above a glass carafe, a flat lower base, a carafe handle, and visible buttons or switches.
spiral or coil: The spiral or coil consists of a continuous strand wound into repeated circular turns, either around a central axis or across a flat plane with a central opening.
combination lock: The combination lock has a compact body, a curved U-shaped shackle or latch, and a numbered circular dial or aligned rows of numbered wheels.
computer keyboard: The computer keyboard has a low rectangular housing covered with staggered rows of labeled keys, a long space bar, and often separate arrow and numeric key groups.
candy store: The candy store has shelves, jars, bins, and display cases densely filled with colorful sweets, wrapped pieces, lollipops, and chocolate packages, often with small price labels.
container ship: The container ship has a long deep hull, a deck covered by stacked rectangular containers in regular rows, and a tall windowed superstructure above part of the stacks.
convertible: The convertible has a car body with an open passenger compartment, an exposed windshield frame, visible seat backs, and often a folded fabric roof behind the seats.
corkscrew: The corkscrew has a pointed helical metal shaft beneath a crosswise handle, sometimes flanked by two hinged side levers and a circular lower frame.
cornet: The cornet has tightly curved brass-colored tubing, three adjacent valve buttons, a cup-shaped mouthpiece, and a broad flared bell aligned with the compact tube bundle.
cowboy boot: The cowboy boot has a tall shaped shaft, a pointed or rounded toe, a slanted raised heel, side pull loops, and curved contrasting stitching across the upper.
cowboy hat: The cowboy hat has a high creased crown, a broad brim with upward-curved sides, and a narrow band around the base of the crown.
cradle: The cradle has an elongated bed frame with raised sides, a flat mattress area, and curved runners beneath the base or a suspended basket between end supports.
construction crane: The construction crane has a tall mast or wheeled base, a long angled or horizontal lattice boom, suspended cables, and a hanging hook block beneath the boom.
crash helmet: The crash helmet has a rounded shell, a broad face opening or transparent visor, a curved lower rim, and a chin strap, often with visible vents.
crate: The crate has a rectangular box frame with slatted or lattice sides, repeated open gaps, a flat base, and often rectangular hand openings near the upper edges.
infant bed: The infant bed has a rectangular mattress enclosed by tall slatted side rails and end panels, with closely spaced vertical bars and a raised frame on short legs.
Crock Pot: The Crock Pot has a deep oval or round body, a fitted lid with a central knob, short side handles, and a front dial or control panel.
croquet ball: The croquet ball is a uniformly colored sphere, often red, blue, yellow, or black, with a finely grooved, crosshatched, or concentric-ring surface.
crutch: The crutch has a long narrow frame, a padded crosspiece or curved cuff at the top, a lower horizontal handgrip, and a single shaft ending in a rubber foot.
cuirass: The cuirass has a torso-shaped front shell joined to a back shell by shoulder and side straps, with curved chest contours, arm openings, and a defined waist edge.
dam: The dam has a broad wall or embankment spanning a waterway, a continuous top edge, a steep downstream face, and often repeated spillway channels or rectangular gates.
desk: The desk has a broad flat top above an open knee space, with side legs or drawer pedestals and often shallow drawers directly beneath the front edge.
desktop computer: The desktop computer has a monitor on a stand, a separate rectangular case with vents and ports, a keyboard, and often a mouse connected by visible cables.
rotary dial telephone: The rotary dial telephone has a curved handset on a cradle, a broad base, a circular numbered finger dial, and a coiled or straight cord.
diaper: The diaper has a broad padded central panel, gathered edges around two leg openings, a waistband, and overlapping side tabs or seams, often with printed colored motifs.
digital clock: The digital clock has a rectangular display showing grouped segmented numerals separated by a colon, within a box-shaped or rounded case with visible control buttons.
digital watch: The digital watch has a numeric display in a compact wrist-shaped case, side buttons, and two strap sections with a buckle, clasp, or adjustment holes.
dining table: The dining table has a broad flat rectangular, oval, or round top supported by legs or a pedestal, with chairs arranged around its edges.
dishcloth: The dishcloth is a square or rectangular woven cloth with hemmed edges, often showing a checked, striped, looped, or waffle-patterned surface and loose folds.
dishwasher: The dishwasher has a rectangular cabinet front, a broad hinged door, a horizontal handle, and a narrow upper strip of buttons, labels, or a small display.
disc brake: The disc brake has a flat circular metal rotor with a central mounting hub, concentric surface marks, and a thick caliper fitted around one section of the outer edge.
dock: The dock has a flat platform extending along or over water, repeated planks or slabs, vertical support piles, and often cleats, railings, or boats beside its edges.
dog sled: The dog sled has two long parallel runners with upturned fronts, a narrow platform or basket, an upright rear handle frame, and often harness lines extending forward.
dome: The dome has a rounded convex roof rising from a circular or polygonal base, with a continuous curved outline and often radial ribs converging at the top.
doormat: The doormat is a flat rectangular or semicircular pad with a coarse bristled, ribbed, or openwork surface, typically framed by a defined border near a doorway.
drilling rig: The drilling rig has a tall lattice derrick above a broad platform, with vertical pipe sections, cables, cross-bracing, and clustered cylindrical tanks or machinery around the base.
drum: The drum has a cylindrical shell, a taut circular head across an end, metal hoops around the rim, and repeated tension rods or cords along the sides.
drumstick: The drumstick has a long straight rounded shaft, a narrower tapered shoulder, and a small bead-shaped or rounded tip, often with visible wood grain.
dumbbell: The dumbbell has a short central handgrip between two matching bulky ends, which may be round discs, spheres, or polygonal blocks.
Dutch oven: The Dutch oven has a deep round thick-walled pot body, two short side handles, and a closely fitted lid with a central knob or arched handle.
electric fan: The electric fan has several broad curved blades around a central hub, usually inside a circular wire grille, mounted on a short base or vertical pedestal.
electric guitar: The electric guitar has a thin contoured body, a long fretted neck, strings over rectangular pickups, control knobs, and a headstock with tuning pegs.
electric locomotive: The electric locomotive has a long box-shaped body, cab windows at one or both ends, side ventilation grilles, visible wheel assemblies, and often a raised roof pantograph.
entertainment center: The entertainment center has a broad cabinet frame with a central television opening, surrounding shelves, and lower cupboards or drawers containing rectangular boxes with buttons, displays, and circular knobs.
envelope: The envelope is a flat rectangular paper sleeve with folded overlapping seams, a triangular or straight-edged flap, and often address writing, a stamp, or a printed label.
espresso machine: The espresso machine has a box-shaped body, projecting handles beneath a front head, a perforated drip tray, control knobs or buttons, and a narrow curved metal side tube.
face powder: The face powder appears as a pale beige, pink, or brown fine-grained surface in a shallow round or rectangular pan, often within a hinged compact beside a puff or brush.
feather boa: The feather boa is a long curved strip densely covered with overlapping feathers, producing a thick irregular outline with fine barbs projecting along its entire length.
filing cabinet: The filing cabinet has an upright or wide rectangular body, stacked deep drawers, horizontal pull handles, and often small label frames centered on each drawer front.
fireboat: The fireboat has a broad boat hull, a raised cabin, railings, coiled hoses, and multiple short angled nozzles mounted on the deck or cabin roof.
fire truck: The fire truck has a boxy cab, roof light bars, side equipment compartments, coiled or folded hoses, and a long ladder mounted along the top or rear.
fire screen: The fire screen has a freestanding rectangular or arched frame containing fine mesh or glass, often with hinged side panels and short feet in front of a fireplace opening.
flagpole: The flagpole is a tall slender vertical shaft with a flag attached near the upper end, often with a rounded finial and a rope along one side.
flute: The flute has a long narrow cylindrical body, a side opening near one end, and a row of circular keys connected by slender rods along its length.
folding chair: The folding chair has a flat seat and back panel on a narrow frame, with crossed or hinged side legs and visible pivot joints below the seat.
football helmet: The football helmet has a rounded shell with ear openings, a projecting cage of bars across the face opening, a chin strap, and often printed side emblems.
forklift: The forklift has a compact wheeled body, an open-sided overhead frame, a vertical front mast, and two long parallel horizontal prongs close to the ground.
fountain: The fountain has a basin with a central raised structure or visible nozzles, often surrounded by arcing water columns, droplets, or stacked shallow bowls.
fountain pen: The fountain pen has a slender barrel, a removable cap, and an exposed pointed metal nib with a central slit and a small hole near its base.
four-poster bed: The four-poster bed has a rectangular bed frame with a tall upright post at each corner, often linked by overhead rails above the mattress.
freight car: The freight car has a long rectangular or tank-shaped body on paired railway wheel assemblies, with end couplers and often sliding side doors, ribs, or open upper edges.
French horn: The French horn has a circular coil of brass-colored tubing, a broad flared bell facing sideways, a narrow mouthpiece tube, and a cluster of valve levers near the center.
frying pan: The frying pan has a broad round flat base, shallow sloping sides, an open rim, and a single long handle extending horizontally from one side.
fur coat: The fur coat has a long or hip-length garment body covered with dense visible hairs, a thick collar, broad sleeves, and often striped panels formed by differences in fur direction.
garbage truck: The garbage truck has a cab ahead of a tall enclosed body, broad wheels, panel seams, and a broad rear or side opening with visible lifting arms or hinged assemblies.
gas mask or respirator: The gas mask or respirator has a molded facepiece over the nose and mouth, circular projecting cartridges or a front canister, head straps, and sometimes paired clear eye lenses.
gas pump: The gas pump has an upright rectangular cabinet, a numeric display, selection buttons, and one or more hanging hoses ending in pistol-shaped nozzles fitted into side recesses.
goblet: The goblet has a rounded or conical open cup above a slender stem and a broad circular foot, often with a reflective or transparent surface.
go-kart: The go-kart has a low exposed frame, four small wide tires, a single low seat, a steering wheel, and exposed rear pipes, housings, and chain links without an enclosed cabin.
golf ball: The golf ball is a pale or colored sphere covered with evenly spaced shallow dimples, often with a printed number, logo, or short alignment line.
golf cart: The golf cart has a short four-wheeled body, open sides, a bench seat, a steering wheel, and a flat roof supported by thin upright posts.
gondola: The gondola has a long narrow black hull with high pointed ends, an asymmetrical curved outline, low seats, and often a tall curved metal ornament at the bow.
gong: The gong is a broad circular metal disc suspended vertically within a frame, with a raised or flat central area and concentric tonal bands across its surface.
gown: The gown has a fitted or shaped upper bodice joined to a long skirt, with a defined neckline and a hem extending toward the feet, often with pleats or draped folds.
grand piano: The grand piano has a broad horizontal body with one straight side and one curved side, a hinged top lid, a front keyboard, three legs, and low projecting pedals.
greenhouse: The greenhouse has transparent or translucent walls and roof divided by a regular supporting frame, with rows of plants, pots, or benches visible through the panels.
radiator grille: The radiator grille has a framed panel of repeated horizontal bars, vertical slats, or mesh openings on a vehicle's front, often centered between the headlights.
grocery store: The grocery store has aisles of shelves stacked with packaged foods, bins of produce, price labels, and counters or refrigerated display cases along the surrounding walls.
guillotine: The guillotine has two tall parallel uprights joined at the top, a broad angled metal blade between them, and a horizontal board with a round opening near the base.
hair clip: The hair clip has two elongated curved or toothed pieces joined at one end, or an arched patterned bar above a narrow clasp, often with a visible hinge.
hair spray: The hair spray container has a tall cylindrical can or bottle, a narrow push nozzle beneath a cap, and printed product lettering or hair-related imagery on the label.
half-track: The half-track has a boxy vehicle body, ordinary front wheels, and continuous tracks wrapped around several rear wheels, often with angular panels and an open upper compartment.
hammer: The hammer has a long handle joined crosswise to a metal head, with a flat circular or square face at one end and a claw or rounded projection at the other.
hamper: The hamper has a deep upright basket-shaped body, woven or fabric side panels, a broad top opening or lid, and often side handles.
hair dryer: The hair dryer has a rounded barrel with a circular rear grille, a narrower front nozzle, a downward-projecting handle with switches, and a cord extending from the handle.
hand-held computer: The hand-held computer has a compact rectangular body, a screen above physical buttons or a miniature keyboard, and often a separate thin stylus beside the display.
handkerchief: The handkerchief is a square piece of fine woven fabric with a narrow hem, often folded into overlapping triangles or rectangles and decorated with a border or embroidery.
hard disk drive: The hard disk drive has a flat rectangular metal case, screw holes around the edges, a printed top label, and a row of connector sockets along one short end.
harmonica: The harmonica has a narrow rectangular body, rounded metal cover plates, and a straight row of evenly spaced rectangular openings along one long edge.
harp: The harp has a triangular frame formed by an upright pillar, a curved upper neck, and a sloped broad body, with many parallel strings of gradually differing lengths.
combine harvester: The combine harvester has a tall boxy body, an elevated glazed cab, large wheels or tracks, a broad front header with repeated bars or teeth, and a projecting side pipe.
hatchet: The hatchet has a short straight or curved handle and a wedge-shaped metal head with a broad curved cutting edge on one side and a blunt opposite end.
holster: The holster has a shaped open-topped pouch, a narrow lower end, stitched or riveted edges, and belt loops or straps, often with a curved upper retaining flap.
home theater: The home theater has a broad screen or television facing a sofa or recliners, with separate tall or box-shaped speakers arranged around the screen and seating area.
honeycomb: The honeycomb has a dense repeated grid of open hexagonal cells, thin pale yellow or brown walls, and a flat or gently curved overall sheet-like form.
hook: The hook has a narrow shaft ending in a pronounced curved J-shaped or U-shaped tip, often with an eyelet, screw thread, or flat mounting plate at the opposite end.
hoop skirt: The hoop skirt has a narrow waistband above a broad bell-shaped outline, with horizontal circular hoops connected by vertical strips or visible as ridges beneath fabric.
gymnastic horizontal bar: The gymnastic horizontal bar has a single narrow cylindrical crossbar between two tall vertical posts, with tension cables extending diagonally from the posts to floor anchors.
horse-drawn vehicle: The horse-drawn vehicle has a raised carriage or cart body on spoked wheels, a forward-facing seat, and long shafts or a pole connected to a horse's harness.
hourglass: The hourglass has two clear bulbs joined by a narrow central neck, sand collected in one or both bulbs, and often a frame with matching top and bottom plates.
iPod: The iPod has a slim rectangular body, a screen on the upper front, and often a circular control wheel with a central button below the screen.
clothes iron: The clothes iron has a pointed flat soleplate beneath a raised body, a large arched top handle, and often a temperature dial, water opening, and trailing cord.
carved pumpkin: The carved pumpkin has an orange ribbed rounded body, a short thick stem, and cutout facial openings such as triangular eyes and a broad jagged mouth.
jeans: The jeans have two trouser legs, a waistband with belt loops, visible rivets, contrasting stitched seams, curved front pockets, and patch pockets on the back.
jeep: The jeep has a boxy body, upright windshield, prominent wheel arches, thick tires, high ground clearance, and often round headlights beside a vertical-slotted front grille.
T-shirt: The T-shirt has a simple fabric torso, two short sleeves extending sideways, a round or V-shaped neck opening, and a straight lower hem.
jigsaw puzzle: The jigsaw puzzle has numerous flat pieces with interlocking rounded tabs and matching indentations, forming a printed picture with a visible network of irregular seams.
rickshaw: The rickshaw has a raised passenger seat between two large wheels, a curved canopy in many examples, and long forward shafts or a bicycle frame attached at the front.
joystick: The joystick has a vertical or slightly tilted grip rising from a broad base, with buttons on the grip or base and often a trigger beneath the upper handle.
kimono: The kimono has straight overlapping front panels, broad rectangular sleeves, a long straight hem, and a wide waist sash, often with repeated printed or embroidered patterns.
knee pad: The knee pad has a rounded padded front panel, curved side edges, and straps or a fabric sleeve behind it, often with a smooth outer cap and stitched border.
knot: The knot has rope, cord, or string crossing through one or more loops, creating a compact cluster of overlapping curved strands with separate ends extending outward.
lab coat: The lab coat has a long usually white fabric body, long sleeves, a buttoned front, notched lapels, and broad patch pockets at the chest or hips.
ladle: The ladle has a long narrow handle attached to a deep rounded bowl, often with an angled neck and a hooked or flattened handle end.
lampshade: The lampshade has an open-ended conical, cylindrical, or bell-shaped shell, often with a wider lower rim, pleated sides, and a thin supporting frame.
laptop computer: The laptop computer has a flat screen hinged to a rectangular base containing a keyboard and touchpad, with ports along the sides and a narrow seam around the lid.
lawn mower: The lawn mower has a low broad deck on wheels, an upper motor housing, and a long angled handle or raised seat, often with a rear collection bag.
lens cap: The lens cap is a flat circular disc with a raised rim, often with two inset spring tabs, molded lettering, and a short retaining cord.
letter opener: The letter opener has a narrow flat pointed blade joined to a longer handle, often with a symmetrical tapered outline and a carved or patterned handle end.
library: The library has long rows of book-filled shelves, broad aisles, tables or desks with chairs, and often shelf-end labels and repeated overhead lights.
lifeboat: The lifeboat has a deep boat-shaped hull, raised rounded sides, a pointed bow, and often an orange enclosed canopy, external ropes, or mounting hooks.
lighter: The lighter has a compact rectangular or cylindrical body, a metal top with a small nozzle, and a ridged wheel or push lever, sometimes beneath a hinged lid.
limousine: The limousine has an unusually elongated car body, a long section between the front and rear wheels, multiple side windows, and a continuous extended roofline.
ocean liner: The ocean liner has a long ship hull, a pointed bow, multiple stacked decks with rows of windows, funnels above the superstructure, and lifeboats along the sides.
lipstick: The lipstick has a colored cylindrical stick with a slanted or rounded tip projecting from a short tube, usually accompanied by a matching removable cap.
slip-on shoe: The slip-on shoe has a low enclosed upper, a broad foot opening, an uninterrupted front without laces, and often a stitched toe panel or a strap across the instep.
lotion: The lotion appears in a bottle or tube with a pump or flip cap and printed labeling, sometimes beside an opaque white or pale cream-shaped dollop.
music speaker: The music speaker has a box-shaped or rounded cabinet with one or more circular cones on its front, often behind a mesh grille, plus a smaller upper dome or opening.
loupe magnifying glass: The loupe magnifying glass has a thick circular lens in a short rim or barrel, often attached to a hinged folding cover, with no long handle.
sawmill: The sawmill has a shed or open framework containing long log supports, a visible circular or band-shaped saw assembly, and stacks of logs and rectangular boards.
magnetic compass: The magnetic compass has a circular face with direction letters, degree markings, and a central pointed needle or arrow beneath a clear cover.
messenger bag: The messenger bag has a broad rectangular body, a large flap covering the front opening, a single long shoulder strap, and often visible buckles or front pockets.
mailbox: The mailbox has a box-shaped or rounded-top enclosure, a narrow slot or hinged front door, printed numbers or lettering, and often a mounting post or wall bracket.
tights: The tights have a close-fitting waistband joined to two long tapered legs with enclosed feet, forming a continuous fabric outline without separate socks.
one-piece bathing suit: The one-piece bathing suit has a continuous fitted torso panel, shoulder straps or an upper neck opening, and two high-cut leg openings joined by a narrow lower section.
manhole cover: The manhole cover is a circular or square plate set within a matching ground-level rim, with raised grid patterns, lettering, and small recessed lifting openings.
maraca: The maraca has a rounded oval or spherical head attached to a short narrow handle, often with a painted surface and a visible seam around the head.
marimba: The marimba has two staggered rows of rectangular wooden bars arranged by length above many vertical tubes, all supported by a long horizontal frame with legs.
mask: The mask has a curved face-shaped surface with eye openings, modeled nose and mouth features, and often side straps, painted patterns, or a handle extending from an edge.
matchstick: The matchstick has a thin straight wooden or paper shaft and a rounded colored coating at one tip, often red, brown, green, or black.
maypole: The maypole has a tall vertical pole topped by a ring, wreath, or ornament, with long multicolored ribbons extending downward or diagonally from near the top.
maze: The maze has repeated branching corridors bounded by hedges, walls, or drawn lines, with angular turns, enclosed dead ends, and a dense interconnected pattern.
measuring cup: The measuring cup has a round or tapered cup body, a projecting side handle, a small pouring lip, and visible graduated lines or printed volume labels.
medicine cabinet: The medicine cabinet has a shallow wall-mounted rectangular body, a mirrored or framed front door, and often narrow shelves with bottles or tubes visible when the door is open.
megalith: The megalith has a broad irregular stone slab or upright block, a coarse unpolished surface, and often other standing stones or horizontal capstones arranged beside or above it.
microphone: The microphone has a rounded or cylindrical mesh head on a narrow body, often with a small switch, cable socket, or stand attachment near the lower end.
microwave oven: The microwave oven has a box-shaped body, a broad front door with a dark rectangular window, a side handle or push latch, and an adjacent keypad or dial panel.
military uniform: The military uniform has matching structured jacket and trousers, visible patch pockets, shoulder tabs, badges or insignia, and often camouflage patterns or rows of contrasting buttons.
milk can: The milk can has a tall cylindrical metal body, rounded shoulders, a narrower neck, a fitted circular lid, and two curved side handles near the top.
minibus: The minibus has a short bus-shaped body, a high roof, several tall side windows, a broad front windshield, and a passenger door extending close to the floor.
miniskirt: The miniskirt has a waistband above a short straight, flared, or pleated fabric body, with an open lower hem positioned well above the knees when worn.
minivan: The minivan has a tall rounded car body, a short sloping hood, several side windows, long sliding-door outlines, and a broad rear hatch beneath an extended roof.
missile: The missile has an elongated cylindrical body, a pointed nose, visible panel seams, and several narrow triangular fins arranged symmetrically near the rear or middle.
mitten: The mitten has a rounded enclosed main section for four fingers, a separate thumb projection, and a narrow wrist opening with a ribbed or gathered cuff.
mixing bowl: The mixing bowl has a broad circular opening, deep smoothly curved sides, and a flat or ring-shaped base, usually without a long handle or spout.
mobile home: The mobile home has an elongated single-story rectangular body, repeated side windows, a shallow roof, a side entrance with steps, and often skirting around an elevated base.
ford model t: The Ford Model T has a narrow upright radiator, separate round headlights, a boxy cabin, thin spoked wheels, curved fenders, and running boards below the doors.
modem: The modem has a compact rectangular casing, a row of labeled indicator lights, ventilation slots, and several rear or side sockets of differing shapes.
monastery: The monastery has a connected complex of masonry buildings around courtyards, repeated arched walkways or window rows, enclosed perimeter walls, and often towers or steep roofs.
monitor: The monitor has a broad rectangular display bordered by a bezel, mounted on a pedestal or stand, with control buttons along the lower edge and connectors on the rear.
moped: The moped has a narrow two-wheeled frame, a compact motor below the seat, handlebars, a slim fuel-shaped tank or center panel, and sometimes bicycle-style pedals.
mortar and pestle: The mortar and pestle consists of a thick-walled open bowl and a short club-shaped rod with a broad rounded end, often shown resting against the bowl's rim.
graduation cap: The graduation cap has a flat square board above a close-fitting crown, with a central button and a tassel extending from the button over an edge.
mosque: The mosque has a broad building mass with a dome or domes, arched doorways, patterned facades, and often slender minarets rising beside a courtyard.
mosquito net: The mosquito net is a fine translucent mesh sheet draped from an overhead point or frame, forming a box-shaped or tent-shaped enclosure with loose lower edges.
vespa: The vespa has a step-through scooter body, a broad curved front leg shield, an enclosed rounded rear body, small wheels, and a handlebar-mounted headlight.
mountain bike: The mountain bike has a triangular frame, straight handlebars, thick deeply treaded tires, spoked wheels, exposed gear components, and often a thick front suspension fork.
tent: The tent has a fabric shell stretched over poles into a domed, ridged, or tapered shape, with a zippered entrance, seams, and anchoring cords extending to the ground.
computer mouse: The computer mouse has a low rounded hand-shaped shell, two upper button areas, a central scroll wheel, and sometimes a cable extending from the front.
mousetrap: The mousetrap has a flat rectangular base, a wire spring, a hinged metal bar, and a small raised trigger plate arranged in a compact exposed assembly.
moving van: The moving van has a tall rectangular enclosed cargo body behind a shorter cab, broad flat side panels, paired rear doors or a roller door, and multiple road wheels.
muzzle: The muzzle has a basket-shaped cage or a short fabric sleeve around an animal's snout, with a nose opening, side straps, and buckles behind the head.
metal nail: The metal nail has a straight slender shaft, a sharply tapered point, and a flat round or rectangular head wider than the shaft at the opposite end.
neck brace: The neck brace has a thick curved collar surrounding the neck, a raised chin-shaped front edge, and overlapping side fasteners, sometimes with ventilation holes or contrasting padded borders.
necklace: The necklace forms a loop or open arc of linked chain, beads, or cord, often with a central hanging pendant and a small clasp near the ends.
baby pacifier: The baby pacifier has a short rounded nipple projecting from a broad curved shield, ventilation holes in the shield, and a ring or knob on the opposite side.
notebook computer: The notebook computer has a hinged clamshell body, a rectangular screen in the upper half, and a keyboard with a touchpad or pointing control in the lower half.
obelisk: The obelisk is a tall four-sided shaft that tapers upward to a pyramid-shaped point, usually above a wider square base, with flat faces and straight vertical edges.
oboe: The oboe has a slender dark tube, many silver keys and rods, a slightly flared lower bell, and a narrow exposed double-reed tip at the top.
ocarina: The ocarina has a rounded enclosed vessel-shaped body, several round finger holes across its upper surface, and a short projecting mouthpiece, often with a tapered end.
odometer: The odometer has a narrow rectangular window displaying a horizontal row of numerals, often within a vehicle dial or instrument panel and beside a miles or kilometers label.
oil filter: The oil filter has a short cylindrical canister with a flat or domed end, printed side markings, and a circular base with a central threaded opening and smaller surrounding holes.
pipe organ: The pipe organ has rows of tall vertical metal or wooden pipes arranged by height above or behind a console with stacked keyboards, knobs, and long floor pedals.
oscilloscope: The oscilloscope has a box-shaped body, a screen with a grid and plotted traces, multiple rotary knobs, small buttons, and round cable sockets across its front panel.
overskirt: The overskirt has an upper skirt layer over a separate lower skirt, with open, split, gathered, or asymmetrical panels that expose part of the fabric beneath.
bullock cart: The bullock cart has a wooden platform or box on large wheels, a long forward pole, and a transverse yoke across the necks of one or more visible oxen.
oxygen mask: The oxygen mask has a transparent molded facepiece, an elastic head strap, side openings, and a projecting lower connector attached to a narrow clear tube.
product packet / packaging: The product packet or packaging has a compact wrapper or pouch with sealed or folded edges, printed branding, colored graphics, and often a flat rectangular front panel.
paddle: The paddle has a long straight shaft ending in a broad flattened blade, with a rounded or tapered blade tip and often a crosswise grip at the other end.
paddle wheel: The paddle wheel has two circular side frames joined by repeated broad rectangular blades around the perimeter, with a central axle and radial supporting spokes.
padlock: The padlock has a compact rectangular or rounded body, a thick curved U-shaped shackle, and a visible keyhole or circular key cylinder on one face or edge.
paintbrush: The paintbrush has a long tapered handle, a metal band near one end, and a dense flat or rounded bundle of bristles with a straight or pointed tip.
pajamas: The pajamas usually form a matching loose shirt and trousers, with a buttoned or pullover top, a gathered waistband, and repeated stripes, checks, or printed motifs.
palace: The palace has a broad symmetrical facade, repeated rows of tall windows, decorated columns and cornices, a central entrance, and often multiple wings around a large courtyard.
pan flute: The pan flute has a row or curved array of narrow tubes joined side by side, with open upper ends aligned and lower ends forming a stepped diagonal outline.
paper towel: The paper towel has a pale embossed or dotted paper surface, usually arranged as a cylindrical roll with a central cardboard tube and transverse perforation lines between sheets.
parachute: The parachute has a broad domed or rectangular fabric canopy divided into stitched panels, with many thin suspension lines converging toward straps or a harness beneath it.
parallel bars: The parallel bars have two long horizontal rails aligned side by side at equal height, supported by four upright posts attached to a broad floor frame.
park bench: The park bench has an elongated seat, a broad upright or sloping backrest, multiple supporting legs, and often repeated horizontal slats and curved side armrests.
parking meter: The parking meter has a compact rounded or rectangular head on a narrow post, with a display window, printed markings, coin slots, and a knob or buttons.
railroad car: The railroad car has an elongated enclosed body, repeated side windows, end doors, and two railway wheel assemblies beneath a continuous roof, with couplers at the ends.
patio: The patio is a flat paved area beside a building, with visible brick, stone, or tile joints and often chairs, a table, planters, or a low surrounding wall.
payphone: The payphone has a box-shaped wall or pedestal unit, a handset attached by a metal-sheathed cord, a keypad, coin or card slots, and printed instruction panels.
pedestal: The pedestal has a narrow upright column or block between a wider flat top and a broad base, often with stepped edges or raised surface moldings.
pencil case: The pencil case has an elongated box or pouch body, a hinged lid or zippered opening, and often pencils, pens, or erasers visible within the open top.
pencil sharpener: The pencil sharpener has a compact body with a round pencil-sized opening, an exposed blade beside the opening or a shavings compartment, and sometimes a side crank.
perfume: The perfume appears in a transparent or colored glass bottle with a fitted shaped cap or short spray nozzle, often with a printed label and visible pale liquid.
Petri dish: The Petri dish has a shallow transparent circular body, a flat base, a low vertical rim, and a slightly wider matching circular lid.
photocopier: The photocopier has a broad box-shaped body, a flat upper lid or paper feeder, a slanted control panel, stacked lower trays, and a recessed output opening.
plectrum: The plectrum is a thin flat triangular or teardrop-shaped piece with rounded corners, a pointed lower tip, and often a printed logo or textured grip area.
Pickelhaube: The Pickelhaube has a rounded dark helmet shell, a projecting front visor, metal edging, a prominent front badge, and a pointed spike centered on the crown.
picket fence: The picket fence has repeated narrow upright boards with pointed or rounded tops, even gaps, and horizontal backing rails connecting the boards between thicker posts.
pickup truck: The pickup truck has a front cab with one or two seat rows, a separate open rectangular rear bed, a hinged tailgate, and prominent rear wheel arches.
pier: The pier has a long raised deck extending from shore over water, repeated support piles underneath, and often continuous side railings and a wider end platform.
piggy bank: The piggy bank has a rounded pig-shaped body, a projecting snout, two ears, four short feet, and a narrow coin slot along the back.
pill bottle: The pill bottle has a short cylindrical body, a wide screw cap often with ridged sides, and a printed label, commonly with translucent orange or opaque white walls.
pillow: The pillow has a rounded rectangular or square fabric body, bulging upper and lower surfaces, stitched edge seams, and corners that taper outward from the center.
ping-pong ball: The ping-pong ball is a plain white or orange sphere with a smooth matte surface, a faint equatorial seam in some examples, and small printed lettering.
pinwheel: The pinwheel has several folded triangular vanes arranged around a central pin, with curled outer edges and a thin straight stick extending downward from the center.
pirate ship: The pirate ship has a high-sided wooden hull, tall masts, crosswise spars, rigging, sails, and often rows of square side openings and a black skull-emblem flag.
drink pitcher: The drink pitcher has a deep open body, a projecting pouring lip at the rim, a broad curved side handle, and a flat or ring-shaped base.
block plane: The block plane has a compact low metal body, a flat sole, a slanted exposed blade assembly, a rounded top cap, and a small front knob or finger rest.
planetarium: The planetarium interior has a broad hemispherical ceiling above rows of seats, often with star-like light patterns across the dome and a central multi-lens projector assembly.
plastic bag: The plastic bag has thin creased walls, a broad top opening, sealed side and bottom seams, and often two loop-shaped handles cut into or attached above the opening.
plate rack: The plate rack has a supporting frame with repeated narrow slots, upright pegs, or parallel wire dividers, often containing plates aligned vertically side by side.
farm plow: The farm plow has a long frame supporting one or more curved metal blades or discs, with pointed lower edges, attachment bars, and sometimes a pair of guiding handles.
plunger: The plunger has a straight upright handle ending in a broad cup-shaped lower section, with a circular rim and sometimes a narrower projecting flange beneath the cup.
Polaroid camera: The Polaroid camera has a boxy or folding body, a front lens and viewfinder, and a wide horizontal slot below the lens, often with a white-bordered photograph protruding.
pole: The pole is a long straight narrow shaft with a circular or polygonal cross-section, a continuous surface, and a plain, capped, or pointed end.
police van: The police van has a tall enclosed vehicle body, roof-mounted light bars, prominent police lettering or emblems, and often contrasting stripes and partly covered rear windows.
poncho: The poncho has a broad fabric panel draped over the shoulders, a central head opening, open sides, and a low continuous hem, often with a hood or fringe.
pool table: The pool table has a rectangular cloth-covered top, raised padded rails, six dark pockets at the corners and side centers, and a broad supporting base.
soda bottle: The soda bottle has a narrow capped neck, rounded shoulders, a clear or colored body, and a printed label, often with molded side curves and a lobed base.
plant pot: The plant pot has an open round or polygonal rim, tapered or straight sides, a flat base, and often dark soil and plant stems visible above the opening.
potter's wheel: The potter's wheel has a flat circular upper plate centered within a shallow tray, a low supporting body or frame, and often a foot pedal beside the base.
power drill: The power drill has a pistol-shaped housing, a downward handle with a trigger, a cylindrical front chuck, and a narrow projecting bit, with a cord or block-shaped battery below.
prayer rug: The prayer rug has a narrow rectangular woven body, a patterned border, a central arch-shaped motif, and often fringe along the short ends.
printer: The printer has a box-shaped housing, a paper tray or raised feeder, a narrow output opening, and a control panel with buttons or a small display.
prison: The prison has repeated barred doors or windows, long rows of enclosed cells or block-shaped buildings, and often high perimeter walls, wire-topped fences, or watchtowers.
projectile: The projectile has an elongated cylindrical or tapered body, a pointed or rounded nose, a flat or narrowed base, and often circumferential bands or grooves.
projector: The projector has a rectangular housing, a prominent circular front lens with a surrounding ring, ventilation grilles, control buttons, and connection sockets along a side or rear panel.
hockey puck: The hockey puck is a thick flat black disc with parallel circular faces, a straight cylindrical sidewall, and often a fine crosshatched texture around its edge.
punching bag: The punching bag has an elongated cylindrical or pear-shaped body, stitched seams, a rounded lower end, and straps or chains connecting its upper end to an overhead support.
purse: The purse has a compact pouch-shaped body, a zippered or clasped opening, stitched edges, and sometimes a short strap, curved handle, or patterned front panel.
quill: The quill has a long central feather shaft with tapered barbs along the upper portion and a bare lower shaft ending in an angled pointed nib.
quilt: The quilt has a broad rectangular fabric body covered by stitched geometric lines, often with colored patchwork panels, a bound border, and slightly raised padded sections.
race car: The race car has a low broad body, a narrow ground gap, wide tires, prominent numbers or sponsor lettering, and often an exposed cockpit, rear wing, or front splitter.
racket: The racket has an oval or rounded head enclosing a tightly crossed string grid, a narrow neck, and a straight handle wrapped with a textured grip.
radiator: The radiator has a rectangular array of repeated vertical columns, fins, or flat panels, with visible connecting pipes and often a valve near one lower corner.
radio: The radio has a compact box-shaped body, a speaker grille, a tuning dial or frequency display, control knobs, and often an extending antenna and top handle.
radio telescope: The radio telescope has a broad concave dish on a tall pivoting support frame, with radial ribs and narrow struts extending toward a central structure above the dish.
rain barrel: The rain barrel has a deep cylindrical body beside a downspout, an upper lid or inlet, and a short tap near its base, often above a stand or blocks.
recreational vehicle: The recreational vehicle has a tall box-shaped vehicle body, side windows, a separate side door, exterior access panels, and often a roof extension above the front cab.
fishing casting reel: The fishing casting reel has a spool enclosed between rounded side plates, a short mounting foot, a side crank with one or two knobs, and a narrow line opening.
reflex camera: The reflex camera has a rectangular body, a prominent circular lens, a raised central viewfinder housing, a top shutter button, and textured grip areas.
refrigerator: The refrigerator has a tall rectangular cabinet, one or more broad doors, long handles or recessed grips, and visible door seams, sometimes with an inset front dispenser.
remote control: The remote control has a narrow elongated casing, multiple rows of labeled buttons, a directional button cluster, and often a differently colored button near the top.
restaurant: The restaurant has repeated tables and chairs, visible place settings or menus, aisle space between tables, and often a counter, booth seating, or wall-mounted light fixtures.
revolver: The revolver has a short barrel, a rounded cylinder above the trigger, a curved grip, a trigger guard, and often an exposed hammer behind the cylinder.
rifle: The rifle has a long narrow barrel aligned with a fore-end and shoulder stock, a trigger guard beneath the central body, and often a raised sight or long optical scope.
rocking chair: The rocking chair has a seat, an upright backrest, and legs connected to two long curved runners, often with armrests and repeated vertical back slats.
rotisserie: The rotisserie has a horizontal metal spit or several parallel spits supported at both ends within an open or glass-fronted enclosure, often with fork-like clamps and browned food.
eraser: The eraser is a compact rectangular, wedge-shaped, or rounded block with a matte surface, often with a paper sleeve, printed lettering, and slightly rounded edges.
rugby ball: The rugby ball has an elongated oval shape with rounded pointed ends, four curved panels divided by seams, and a finely textured surface with printed markings.
ruler measuring stick: The ruler measuring stick is a long flat straight strip with evenly spaced tick marks and numbered graduations along one or both edges, often with a small hanging hole.
sneaker: The sneaker has a rounded enclosed toe, a layered fabric or leather-like upper, lace eyelets, a padded ankle opening, and a thick patterned sole.
safe: The safe has a thick rectangular body, a deeply framed front door, visible hinges, and a combination dial, keypad, or keyhole beside a thick handle.
safety pin: The safety pin has a single bent wire forming two parallel arms, a coiled loop at one end, and a clasp covering the pointed tip at the other.
salt shaker: The salt shaker has a short upright container body and a perforated cap with several small holes, often with pale granules visible through a clear lower section.
sandal: The sandal has an exposed flat or raised sole, open toe and side areas, and straps crossing the foot or ankle, often joined by buckles.
sarong: The sarong has a broad rectangular fabric panel wrapped around the waist or torso, an overlapping front or side edge, and a tied or gathered upper corner.
saxophone: The saxophone has a tapered metal body with many circular keys, a curved lower bend, an upward-facing flared bell, and a bent neck ending in a dark mouthpiece.
scabbard: The scabbard has a long narrow sheath-shaped body, an open upper mouth, a closed tapered tip, and often metal end fittings, bands, or suspension rings.
weighing scale: The weighing scale has a flat platform or shallow pan, a numbered dial or digital display, and a base or upright support, sometimes with two suspended pans.
school bus: The school bus has a long yellow body, a row of rectangular side windows, dark horizontal stripes, roof warning lights, and often SCHOOL BUS lettering above the windshield.
schooner: The schooner has a narrow hull, two or more masts with the forward mast no taller than the rear main mast, and fore-and-aft sails stretched along angled booms.
scoreboard: The scoreboard is a broad rectangular panel divided into labeled sections, with large contrasting numerals, team-name areas, and often a central clock-style numeric display.
CRT monitor: The CRT monitor has a deep box-shaped rear housing, a thick front bezel, a curved rectangular screen, lower control buttons, and a broad pedestal base.
screw: The screw has a cylindrical shaft wrapped in a continuous helical ridge, a pointed or flat end, and a wider head with a slot, cross, or shaped recess.
screwdriver: The screwdriver has a thick rounded or faceted handle, a straight narrow metal shaft, and a flattened, cross-shaped, or shaped tip at the far end.
seat belt: The seat belt has a broad woven strap, a flat metal tongue with a rectangular opening, and a matching buckle with a release button, often beside a seat.
sewing machine: The sewing machine has a C-shaped body above a flat base, a needle and presser foot beneath the upper arm, a side handwheel, and visible thread guides or spool pins.
shield: The shield has a broad flat or convex front panel with a defined rim, a round, oval, or tapered outline, and often a central raised boss or painted emblem.
shoe store: The shoe store has rows of footwear displayed on shelves or individual stands, stacks of shoe boxes, low seating benches, and often mirrors near the floor.
shoji screen / room divider: The shoji screen or room divider has rectangular panels divided by a regular wooden lattice, with pale translucent sheets filling the openings and narrow solid border rails.
shopping basket: The shopping basket has an open rectangular or oval body, perforated or lattice sides, a flat base, and one or two hinged handles arching above the opening.
shopping cart: The shopping cart has an open wire or perforated basket above a wheeled frame, a horizontal rear push handle, and often a folding panel near the handle.
shovel: The shovel has a long straight shaft attached to a broad concave blade with a rounded, square, or pointed lower edge, often with a D-shaped upper grip.
shower cap: The shower cap has a loose rounded fabric or thin plastic body gathered around a narrow elastic rim, producing repeated puckers and folds along the lower edge.
shower curtain: The shower curtain has a broad hanging rectangular sheet with repeated holes or rings along its top edge, vertical folds, and a straight lower hem near a tub or stall.
ski: The ski has a long narrow flat body, an upward-curved front tip, a defined side edge, and binding fittings fixed near the middle of the upper surface.
balaclava ski mask: The balaclava ski mask has a close-fitting head-and-neck fabric shape, a broad face opening or separate eye and mouth holes, and a lower edge extending over the neck.
sleeping bag: The sleeping bag has an elongated padded fabric body, a closed rounded or tapered foot end, a long side zipper, and an open head end often shaped into a hood.
slide rule: The slide rule has a long rectangular body with several parallel numbered scales, a central sliding strip, and a transparent cursor crossing the scales with a fine reference line.
sliding door: The sliding door has broad overlapping rectangular panels within horizontal top and bottom tracks, with recessed or vertical handles near the panel edges.
slot machine: The slot machine has an upright cabinet, a front display with aligned symbol columns, rows of buttons, a coin or bill slot, and often a side lever.
snorkel: The snorkel has a curved narrow tube, an open or capped upper end, a lower mouthpiece with two projecting tabs, and often a side clip.
snowmobile: The snowmobile has a low body with a raised seat, handlebars and a windshield, two narrow front skis, and a broad rear track beneath the body.
snowplow: The snowplow has a truck-shaped or tractor-shaped body with a broad curved blade across the front, visible blade supports, and often a rear box or hopper.
soap dispenser: The soap dispenser has a rounded or rectangular container with a downward or sideways nozzle, and a top pump, front push panel, or small sensor window.
soccer ball: The soccer ball is a sphere divided into stitched or molded polygonal panels, often with alternating black pentagons and white hexagons or contrasting curved panel graphics.
sock: The sock has a narrow tubular knitted leg section, a shaped heel bend, a closed rounded toe, and a ribbed cuff around its upper opening.
solar thermal collector: The solar thermal collector has a dark flat glazed panel or parallel cylindrical tubes on an angled frame, with visible pipe connections and sometimes a horizontal tank above.
sombrero: The sombrero has a tall rounded or pointed crown, an broad brim with an upturned edge, and often patterned stitching, a crown band, or a chin cord.
soup bowl: The soup bowl has a broad round opening, curved sides, and a recessed center, often with a wide rim and visible liquid containing scattered pieces of food.
keyboard space bar: The keyboard space bar is a long horizontal rectangular key centered along the bottom row of a keyboard, with a broad blank top and neighboring shorter keys.
space heater: The space heater has a compact upright or low housing, a broad front grille, a top or side control dial, and a short base or feet.
space shuttle: The space shuttle has a white elongated fuselage, a black nose and lower surface, broad triangular wings, a tall tail fin, and clustered round nozzles at the rear.
spatula: The spatula has a long narrow handle joined to a broad thin flat head, with a straight or rounded leading edge and sometimes parallel slots through the head.
motorboat: The motorboat has a pointed hull, a broad stern, a low windshield and cockpit, and often a visible outboard unit attached to the rear edge.
spider web: The spider web has a network of fine strands, often with radial lines joined by closely spaced concentric threads, forming open triangular and curved polygonal gaps.
spindle: The spindle has a slender tapered shaft, a rounded disc or whorl near one end, and often a conical bundle of yarn wound around the shaft.
sports car: The sports car has a low roofline, a wide body, a long sloping hood, sculpted side panels, broad tires, and often two doors and a short rear cabin.
spotlight: The spotlight has a deep cylindrical or box-shaped housing, a circular front lens or reflector, a bracket around its sides, and often flat hinged panels around the opening.
stage: The stage has a broad raised platform facing an open seating area, with a defined front edge, overhead lighting fixtures, and often curtains or a framed rear backdrop.
steam locomotive: The steam locomotive has a long cylindrical boiler, a front chimney, large spoked wheels linked by external rods, and a box-shaped rear cab behind the boiler.
through arch bridge: The through arch bridge has a roadway passing between two tall arches, with vertical hangers linking the deck to the curved arches and cross-bracing above the roadway.
steel drum: The steel drum has a circular concave metal top divided into outlined oval or rounded rectangular sections, a short cylindrical skirt, and often a surrounding support stand.
stethoscope: The stethoscope has a round metal chestpiece, a long branching tube, and two curved metal ear tubes ending in rounded tips, forming a Y-shaped outline.
scarf: The scarf has a long narrow fabric body, visible woven or knitted texture, and often fringed ends, with repeated folds when looped around a neck or draped over a surface.
stone wall: The stone wall has stacked irregular stones or cut blocks forming a vertical barrier, with visible joints, uneven surface relief, and a continuous flat or irregular top edge.
stopwatch: The stopwatch has a rounded case, a circular dial or numeric display, one or more push buttons on the top edge, and often a loop or cord attachment.
stove: The stove has a rectangular body with circular burners or ring-marked zones on top, front control knobs, and often a lower oven door with a broad handle.
strainer: The strainer has a rounded bowl-shaped wire mesh or perforated cup, a thick rim, a projecting handle, and often a small support loop opposite the handle.
tram: The tram has a long windowed body on steel rails, repeated side doors, often articulated sections, and a roof-mounted pantograph or pole connected to overhead wires.
stretcher: The stretcher has a narrow rectangular fabric or padded bed on a metal frame, projecting end handles, and often side rails, straps, and folding wheeled legs.
couch: The couch has a long padded seat, an upholstered backrest, side armrests, and multiple cushions, usually above short legs or a low enclosed base.
stupa: The stupa has a broad rounded or bell-shaped mound on a stepped base, a small square upper section, and a tapering spire with stacked ring-like elements.
submarine: The submarine has an elongated cylindrical hull with rounded ends, a raised tower on top, and projecting horizontal or vertical fins near the rear.
suit: The suit has a structured jacket with lapels, front buttons, and inset pockets, paired with trousers of matching fabric, color, and pattern.
sundial: The sundial has a flat circular or polygonal face marked with lines and numerals, plus a raised triangular plate or angled rod above the face.
sunglass: The sunglass has dark tinted oval or angular lenses in a frame with a central nose bridge, curved side arms, and reflective highlights across the lenses.
sunglasses: The sunglasses have two dark or tinted lenses joined by a central bridge, a surrounding frame, and two long hinged arms extending backward from the outer edges.
sunscreen: The sunscreen appears in a bottle or tube with a cap, pump, or nozzle, printed SPF labeling, and often sun-shaped graphics, sometimes beside an opaque pale lotion smear.
suspension bridge: The suspension bridge has a long deck below tall towers, two main cables forming broad downward curves between the towers, and many narrow vertical hanging cables.
mop: The mop has a long straight handle attached to a dense bundle of loose strands, a flat fringed pad, or a rectangular sponge-shaped head.
sweatshirt: The sweatshirt has a loose long-sleeved fabric body, a ribbed waistband and cuffs, and a round neckline or hood, often with visible shoulder seams and front graphics.
swim trunks / shorts: The swim trunks or shorts have two short wide leg openings, a gathered waistband, often a front drawstring, and plain or printed fabric with visible side seams.
swing: The swing has a flat or curved seat suspended by two ropes or chains from an overhead beam or branch, leaving open space below the seat.
electrical switch: The electrical switch has a rectangular faceplate containing a projecting toggle, rocker, or push button, often with visible screw heads and small printed markings.
syringe: The syringe has a transparent cylindrical barrel with graduation marks, a projecting plunger with a broad thumb pad, finger flanges, and a narrow nozzle or needle at the opposite end.
table lamp: The table lamp has a compact base, an upright stem or shaped body, and an upper shade or exposed bulb holder, often with a cord extending from the base.
tank: The tank has a low broad angular hull, continuous tracks around multiple side wheels, a raised turret, and a long barrel projecting horizontally from the turret.
tape player: The tape player has a box-shaped front with a cassette compartment or two exposed reel mounts, control buttons, knobs, and often meters or a small display.
teapot: The teapot has a rounded enclosed body, a fitted lid, a curved projecting spout, and a broad handle on the opposite side or arching over the top.
teddy bear: The teddy bear has a rounded plush body, circular ears, bead-like eyes, a stitched or molded nose, and four short rounded limbs with visible seams or paw patches.
television: The television has a broad rectangular screen in a framed housing, a stand or feet, and often lower control buttons, speaker grilles, or a thicker rear casing.
tennis ball: The tennis ball is a yellow-green or white sphere with a short fuzzy surface and a curved pale seam forming two connected rounded panel outlines.
thatched roof: The thatched roof has thick overlapping bundles of straw-like stems, a ridged or uneven surface, a pronounced overhanging eave, and a rounded or sharply defined roof ridge.
front curtain: The front curtain consists of broad hanging fabric panels across a stage opening, with deep vertical folds, a straight lower hem, and often a matching upper valance.
thimble: The thimble has a short tapered cup shape with a rounded closed top, an open circular base, and dense small dimples across its outer surface.
threshing machine: The threshing machine has an elongated box-shaped frame on wheels, broad feed openings, protruding chutes, and visible pulleys, belts, or linked metal assemblies along its sides.
throne: The throne has a broad raised seat, a tall decorated backrest, thick armrests, and often carved finials, contrasting upholstery, and an elevated base or steps.
tile roof: The tile roof has repeated overlapping rows of flat or curved tiles, a regular stepped surface pattern, distinct ridge pieces, and aligned lower edges along the eaves.
toaster: The toaster has a compact rounded rectangular body, one or more narrow slots on top, a side lever, and a front or side dial with marked settings.
tobacco shop: The tobacco shop has shelves and display cases containing rows of cigarette packs, cigar boxes, cylindrical cigars, and pipes, often with printed brand panels behind a counter.
toilet seat: The toilet seat has a smooth oval or rounded rectangular ring with a broad central opening, a pair of rear hinges, and often a matching solid lid.
torch: The torch has a long narrow shaft with a widened cup or wrapped bundle at its upper end, often with a visible yellow-orange flame above the tip.
totem pole: The totem pole has a tall carved wooden shaft with stacked faces and animal-shaped figures, projecting beaks or wings, and contrasting painted areas outlining the features.
tow truck: The tow truck has a cab ahead of a flat rear platform or boom assembly, with visible cables, hooks, or a low wheel cradle behind the rear axle.
toy store: The toy store has shelves and bins filled with boxed toys, dolls, stuffed animals, model vehicles, and board games, often with colorful display stands and printed signs.
tractor: The tractor has a narrow front hood, an elevated seat or glazed cab, deeply treaded tires, and rear wheels often larger than the front wheels.
semi-trailer truck: The semi-trailer truck has a tall front tractor cab connected to a long separate trailer, with multiple axles, a visible articulation gap, and broad rectangular trailer sides.
tray: The tray has a broad shallow flat surface bordered by a low raised rim, often with two handles or cutout grips on opposite sides.
trench coat: The trench coat has a long structured body, overlapping front panels with two rows of buttons, broad lapels, shoulder tabs, and a belt around the waist.
tricycle: The tricycle has one front wheel and two rear wheels, a central seat, handlebars above the front wheel, and pedals attached to the front axle or a crank assembly.
trimaran: The trimaran has a long central hull flanked by two narrower side hulls, with crossbeams connecting all three and often a mast rising above the central deck.
tripod: The tripod has three splayed legs meeting at a central head, a flat upper mounting plate, telescoping leg sections, and visible adjustment clamps or knobs.
triumphal arch: The triumphal arch has a freestanding rectangular masonry mass around one or more tall arched passages, with decorated columns, relief panels, and a broad horizontal upper block.
trolleybus: The trolleybus has a long bus body on rubber tires, rows of side windows, several doors, and two long roof poles angled upward toward overhead wires.
trombone: The trombone has a long U-shaped double-tube slide, a curved rear tube, a flared bell, and a small mouthpiece, with two parallel straight sections projecting forward.
hot tub: The hot tub has a broad deep basin with thick raised sides, a wide rim, molded seat-shaped contours, and small circular fittings around the inner wall.
turnstile: The turnstile has a central pedestal or vertical shaft with several horizontal arms projecting radially, often beside a fixed barrier and a rectangular reader panel.
typewriter keyboard: The typewriter keyboard has staggered rows of raised lettered keys, a long front space bar, and often round key tops on visible stems beneath a carriage and roller.
umbrella: The umbrella has a domed fabric canopy divided into radial panels, thin ribs beneath the surface, a central shaft, and a straight or curved handle.
unicycle: The unicycle has one spoked wheel, pedals on opposite sides of the wheel hub, a fork rising above the wheel, and a narrow curved saddle on a central post.
upright piano: The upright piano has a tall rectangular cabinet behind a horizontal row of black and white keys, a broad front panel, and two or three pedals near the floor.
vacuum cleaner: The vacuum cleaner has a wheeled canister or upright body, a handle, a broad floor head, and often a corrugated hose joined to a straight tube.
vase: The vase has an upright enclosed body, a narrow or flared top opening, and a defined base, often with curved shoulders and a smooth or patterned outer surface.
vaulted or arched ceiling: The vaulted or arched ceiling has an overhead surface formed by continuous curves or intersecting arches, often with ribs meeting at raised central points above supporting columns.
velvet fabric: The velvet fabric has a dense short pile with directional light and dark shading, a continuous fine-textured surface, and broad rounded folds where the fabric is draped.
vending machine: The vending machine has a tall rectangular cabinet, a glass display of aligned products or printed product panels, selection buttons, payment slots, and a lower delivery opening.
vestment: The vestment has a long draped robe-shaped body, broad panels, and contrasting embroidered borders or cross-shaped motifs, often with a long narrow stole layered over the front.
viaduct: The viaduct has an elongated elevated deck supported by a repeated series of piers or arches, with evenly spaced openings continuing across a valley or lower ground.
violin: The violin has a waisted varnished body, two f-shaped openings, four strings, a dark fingerboard, a scroll-shaped head, and a curved chinrest beside the lower tailpiece.
volleyball: The volleyball is a round ball divided into groups of curved rectangular panels, with shallow seams and a pale or multicolored smooth-looking surface.
waffle iron: The waffle iron has two thick hinged plates with matching raised grid patterns, an outer case, a projecting handle, and often a power cord and indicator lights.
wall clock: The wall clock has a framed circular or rectangular face mounted vertically on a wall, with numerals or tick marks around centrally joined hands or a numeric display.
wallet: The wallet has a flat rectangular folded body, stitched edges, and multiple narrow card slots or pockets visible when open, often with a snap or zipper closure.
wardrobe: The wardrobe has a tall enclosed rectangular cabinet body, broad full-height doors, vertical handles, and often a top cornice, lower drawers, or short feet.
military aircraft: The military aircraft has a pointed or rounded fuselage, angular wings, a cockpit canopy, and gray or patterned surfaces, often with insignia, underwing pods, or paired tail fins.
sink: The sink has a recessed round or rectangular basin, a visible drain, a raised rim or countertop edge, and one or more taps above the rear edge.
washing machine: The washing machine has a rectangular cabinet, a circular front door or broad top lid, a control panel with buttons and a dial, and visible panel seams.
water bottle: The water bottle has an elongated cylindrical body, a narrow neck with a screw cap, and often transparent ribbed walls, a wraparound label, and clear liquid.
water jug: The water jug has a deep broad body, a narrow or open top, a broad side handle, and often a short pouring spout or capped neck.
water tower: The water tower has a broad elevated tank with a rounded or cylindrical outline, supported by a narrow central column or a tall open framework of legs and cross-braces.
whiskey jug: The whiskey jug has a rounded or cylindrical body, broad shoulders, a short narrow neck, a fitted stopper, and a small loop handle near the neck.
whistle: The whistle has a short projecting mouthpiece, a compact rounded or cylindrical body, a narrow opening near the mouthpiece, and often a ring attachment at the rear.
hair wig: The hair wig has hair strands arranged around a cap-shaped crown, with a defined hairline, a visible part or bangs, and a continuous styled outer silhouette.
window screen: The window screen has a fine regular mesh stretched across a rectangular frame, with evenly spaced square openings and narrow straight borders fitted within a window opening.
window shade: The window shade has a flat or pleated rectangular sheet covering part of a window, with a top roller or rail, a straight lower bar, and often a pull cord.
Windsor tie: The Windsor tie has a broad symmetrical triangular knot beneath the collar, a wide tapering front blade, and a narrower rear blade partly concealed behind it.
wine bottle: The wine bottle has a tall cylindrical glass body, sloping or angular shoulders, a long narrow neck, and a cork-shaped or screw-capped top, often with a broad paper label.
airplane wing: The airplane wing has a broad flattened root tapering toward a narrow tip, a curved leading edge, a straighter trailing edge, and visible flap seams or panel lines.
wok: The wok has a broad round opening, deep continuously curved sides, a rounded or slightly flattened base, and one long handle or two short side handles.
wooden spoon: The wooden spoon has a long narrow handle ending in a shallow oval or round bowl, with visible wood grain and a continuous tan or brown surface.
wool: The wool appears as tangled crimped fibers, loose fleece-like clumps, or twisted yarn wound into balls or skeins, with many fine hairs projecting from the surface.
split-rail fence: The split-rail fence has thick irregular wooden rails arranged horizontally between upright posts or in a zigzag layout, with broad open gaps and exposed split-grain surfaces.
shipwreck: The shipwreck has a tilted, broken, or partly submerged ship hull, missing panels, exposed ribs or beams, and often irregular edges or rust-colored surface patches.
sailboat: The sailboat has a narrow pointed hull, an upright mast, triangular or quadrilateral sails, visible rigging lines, and a horizontal boom extending from the mast.
yurt: The yurt has a circular wall, a low conical roof, a continuous fabric covering, a rectangular doorway, and often horizontal bands around the outer surface.
website: The website appears as a rectangular page with a header, navigation labels, text blocks, images, and links, often within a browser window showing an address bar.
comic book: The comic book has printed illustrated pages or a pictorial cover, with outlined panels, speech balloons, caption boxes, and bold lettering arranged around drawn figures.
crossword: The crossword has a square grid of white cells interrupted by black blocks, small numbers in selected cell corners, and adjacent lists of numbered text clues.
traffic or street sign: The traffic or street sign has a flat rectangular, circular, triangular, or polygonal panel with contrasting lettering, arrows, or symbols, usually attached to a post or overhead frame.
traffic light: The traffic light has a vertical or horizontal housing containing separate circular red, yellow, and green lenses, often with projecting shades above the lenses.
dust jacket: The dust jacket is a printed paper wrapper around a book, with a front cover panel, a narrow spine panel, and folded flaps tucked around the cover edges.
menu: The menu has printed or handwritten food and drink names arranged in sections, often with aligned prices, bold or enlarged headings, and occasional photographs on a sheet, booklet, or board.
plate: The plate has a broad flat or shallowly recessed center, a raised circular or shaped rim, and a low profile, often with a colored or patterned border.
guacamole: The guacamole forms a pale to dark green mound or spread with an uneven mashed surface, often containing visible red cubes, pale fragments, and green leaf pieces.
consomme: The consomme appears as a clear amber or golden-brown liquid in a bowl or cup, with a reflective surface and sometimes a few separate pale or green garnish pieces.
hot pot: The hot pot appears as a deep pot or casserole containing visible liquid and irregular pieces of meat, vegetables, or pale slices, sometimes arranged in separate surface groups.
trifle: The trifle has alternating pale, yellow, and red layers visible through a glass bowl, a white upper topping, and often fruit pieces or piped swirls on top.
ice cream: The ice cream forms rounded scoops or ridged swirls with a pale or colored opaque surface, usually above a textured cone or within a bowl.
popsicle: The popsicle has an elongated molded body with a rounded or squared top, a smooth colored surface, and a short flat stick projecting from the bottom.
baguette: The baguette has a long narrow loaf shape, tapered or rounded ends, a golden-brown crust, and repeated diagonal slashes across the upper surface.
bagel: The bagel has a thick rounded ring shape, a central hole, a browned smooth or lightly blistered outer surface, and sometimes scattered seeds on top.
