pretzel: The pretzel has a brown rope-shaped body folded into a symmetrical looped knot, with crossing strands, several open gaps, and often pale salt-like crystals on the surface.
cheeseburger: The cheeseburger has a round split bun, a dark flattened patty, and a visible yellow or orange cheese slice extending beyond the patty, often with contrasting vegetable layers.
hot dog: The hot dog has an elongated reddish-brown sausage nested in a split oblong bun, often with narrow zigzag stripes of yellow, red, or green toppings.
mashed potatoes: The mashed potatoes form an off-white or pale yellow mound with rounded peaks, spoon-shaped depressions, and an uneven ridged surface, often with a small central topping.
cabbage: The cabbage has a compact round head of tightly overlapping leaves, broad pale veins, and curled leaf edges, with green, pale yellow-green, or purple coloration.
broccoli: The broccoli has a thick pale green stalk branching into tightly packed dark green bud clusters, forming a broad uneven rounded crown.
cauliflower: The cauliflower has a dense rounded white or cream head made of closely packed lobed clusters, partly enclosed by broad green leaves with thick pale ribs.
zucchini: The zucchini has an elongated cylindrical body, a slightly tapered end, smooth dark or pale green skin, and a thick ridged stem attached at one end.
spaghetti squash: The spaghetti squash has an oval or elongated rounded body, a smooth pale yellow rind, faint lengthwise lines, and a short thick stem at one end.
acorn squash: The acorn squash has a rounded body tapering to a pointed end, deep longitudinal ribs, dark green skin often with an orange patch, and a short thick stem.
butternut squash: The butternut squash has a long narrow neck above a rounded bulbous base, smooth tan skin, a short woody stem, and a small circular scar at the lower end.
cucumber: The cucumber has an elongated green cylindrical body, rounded or tapered ends, fine lengthwise stripes, and often many small raised bumps or pale spines.
artichoke: The artichoke has a rounded tapered head of thick overlapping green or purple-tipped bracts, pointed outer tips, and a broad stalk attached beneath the head.
bell pepper: The bell pepper has a glossy red, green, yellow, or orange body, broad rounded lobes separated by grooves, a depressed top, and a curved green stem.
cardoon: The cardoon has elongated gray-green leaves with deep pointed lobes, pale branching veins, thick ridged stalks, and often rounded heads topped by dense purple threadlike florets.
mushroom: The mushroom has a rounded or flattened cap above a narrower stem, a curved cap edge, and a smooth, scaly, or speckled outer surface.
Granny Smith apple: The Granny Smith apple has a rounded slightly tapered shape, glossy green skin with pale speckles, a recessed stem cavity, and a small dark indentation at the opposite end.
strawberry: The strawberry has a red heart-shaped or conical body, numerous pale seed-like dots in shallow surface pits, and a crown of pointed green leaves.
orange: The orange has a round or slightly flattened body, an orange rind densely covered with fine dimples, and a small circular stem scar.
lemon: The lemon has an oval yellow body, a finely pitted rind, and tapered or nipple-shaped projections at one or both ends.
fig: The fig has a rounded or pear-shaped body, a short narrow stem, purple, brown, or green skin, and a small circular opening at the broader end.
pineapple: The pineapple has an oval cylindrical body covered with repeated diamond-shaped segments, pointed surface scales, and a crown of long narrow serrated green leaves.
banana: The banana has an elongated curved body, several faint lengthwise ridges, a yellow or green peel, a thick stalk end, and a dark pointed tip.
jackfruit: The jackfruit has an elongated oval body, green or yellow-brown skin densely covered with short polygonal bumps, and a thick short stalk at one end.
cherimoya (custard apple): The cherimoya has a rounded heart-shaped body, pale green skin with overlapping scale-like segments or shallow polygonal depressions, and a short stem at the broader end.
pomegranate: The pomegranate has a rounded red or reddish-brown body, slightly angular sides, a smooth outer skin, and a projecting crown of pointed sepals at one end.
hay: The hay appears as a tangled mass of pale yellow, tan, or muted green stems and narrow blades, often forming rectangular bales or cylindrical rolls with visible layered strands.
carbonara: The carbonara has pale pasta strands or tubes coated in a glossy yellow-white sauce, with scattered dark pepper-like specks, browned meat pieces, and pale grated flakes.
chocolate syrup: The chocolate syrup appears as a glossy dark brown coating, smooth pool, or narrow ribbon across a surface, with rounded edges and reflective highlights.
dough: The dough forms a pale rounded mound or flattened sheet with a smooth to lightly dimpled surface, folded edges or shallow creases, and often patches of white flour.
meatloaf: The meatloaf has a thick loaf-shaped or rectangular mound with rounded edges, a browned finely textured exterior, and often a glossy reddish coating across the top.
pizza: The pizza has a broad flat round or rectangular base, a raised browned rim, and a visible top layer of pale cheese, red sauce, and scattered contrasting toppings.
pot pie: The pot pie has a rounded or oval domed pastry top, a golden-brown uneven surface, a crimped edge around a dish, and often small slits in the crust.
burrito: The burrito has a thick cylindrical shape enclosed by a pale tortilla, folded ends, an overlapping side seam, and sometimes scattered brown toasted patches on the surface.
red wine: The red wine appears as a transparent deep red or burgundy liquid, often within a stemmed glass, with a curved meniscus and lighter red highlights near the edges.
espresso: The espresso appears as dark brown liquid in a short cup, usually with a thin tan or golden foam layer marked by small bubbles or mottled patches.
tea cup: The tea cup has a shallow rounded cup body, a narrow curved side handle, a fine circular rim, and often a matching saucer beneath it.
eggnog: The eggnog appears as an opaque pale cream or yellow beverage in a glass or cup, often with a light foam layer and fine brown speckles on top.
mountain: The mountain has steep elevated slopes converging toward a peak or ridge, with visible rock faces, gullies, and overlapping ridgelines above the surrounding lower terrain.
bubble: The bubble has a rounded transparent outline, a thin reflective rim, curved highlights, and often rainbow-colored bands across a surface through which the background remains visible.
cliff: The cliff has a steep or nearly vertical exposed rock face, a sharply defined upper edge, visible cracks or strata, and often angular fragments at its base.
coral reef: The coral reef has dense groups of branching, plate-shaped, rounded, or ridged coral forms beneath water, with irregular gaps and contrasting colored surfaces across the seabed.
geyser: The geyser has a narrow ground-level opening beneath a tall white plume or water column, with scattered droplets and pale mineral crusts around the opening.
lakeshore: The lakeshore has a curved boundary between inland water and land, with rocks, sand, or vegetation along the edge and often an opposite shoreline visible across the water.
promontory: The promontory has a raised narrow mass of land projecting into water, steep sides, and a defined tip surrounded by water on several sides.
sandbar: The sandbar has a low elongated strip of pale sand surrounded or partly bordered by shallow water, often with curved edges and darker wet margins.
beach: The beach has a broad sloping band of sand or pebbles beside open water, a curved shoreline, and often parallel foam lines near the water's edge.
valley: The valley has an elongated low central floor bordered by higher slopes on both sides, with converging ridgelines and often a river-shaped channel along the bottom.
volcano: The volcano has a cone-shaped or broad domed landform with sloping flanks, a summit crater or depression, and often dark radial streaks or bare rocky surfaces.
baseball player: The baseball player wears a brimmed cap or batting helmet, a numbered jersey, belted trousers, and often a leather mitt or visible bat beside the body.
bridegroom: The bridegroom typically wears a suit or tuxedo with a tie or bow tie and a flower on the lapel, often beside a person in a long white gown.
scuba diver: The scuba diver has a close-fitting suit, a face mask, a mouthpiece connected to hoses, one or more back-mounted cylinders, and long fins on the feet.
rapeseed: The rapeseed has upright branching green stems, clusters of yellow four-petaled flowers, and elongated leaves, often forming dense areas of yellow flower heads.
daisy: The daisy has a round yellow central disc surrounded by a ring of long narrow white petals, with a slender green stem and a nearly circular flower outline.
yellow lady's slipper: The yellow lady's slipper has a yellow inflated pouch-shaped lower petal, a small opening above the pouch, twisted brownish side petals, and broad veined green leaves.
corn: The corn plant has a tall jointed stalk, long arching blade-shaped leaves, a branched tassel at the top, and husk-covered ears attached beside the stalk.
acorn: The acorn has a smooth oval brown nut with a slightly pointed end, partly enclosed by a cup-shaped cap covered in overlapping scales.
rose hip: The rose hip has a rounded or elongated red-orange body, a narrow stalk, and persistent dark pointed sepals forming a star-shaped tuft at the opposite end.
horse chestnut seed: The horse chestnut seed has a rounded uneven shape, glossy brown skin, and a broad pale circular scar, sometimes beside a green capsule with widely spaced short spines.
coral fungus: The coral fungus has many upright finger-shaped branches joined at a common base, repeated forked tips, and a pale cream, yellow, orange, or pink surface.
agaric: The agaric has a cap above a central stalk, thin radiating gills beneath the cap, and sometimes a ring around the stalk or pale patches on the cap.
gyromitra: The gyromitra has an irregular brown cap with deep rounded folds and convoluted lobes, above a short pale stalk partly concealed beneath the folded cap.
stinkhorn mushroom: The stinkhorn mushroom has an upright pale porous stalk topped by a darker olive-brown pitted or ridged cap, often with a small opening at the cap's tip.
earth star fungus: The earth star fungus has a rounded central sac surrounded by thick pointed outer lobes spread into a star shape, with a small opening at the top of the sac.
hen of the woods mushroom: The hen of the woods mushroom has a dense cluster of overlapping fan-shaped gray-brown caps, pale margins, wavy edges, and short branching stems converging near the base.
bolete: The bolete has a broad rounded cap, a thick cylindrical or bulbous stalk, and a finely porous underside visible beneath the cap's overhanging edge.
corn cob: The corn cob has an elongated tapered cylindrical outline covered with tightly packed yellow, white, or mixed-color kernels in straight rows, often bordered by folded green husks.
toilet paper: The toilet paper has a short cylindrical roll of thin white or pale sheets around a cardboard tube, with visible perforation lines and often a fine embossed pattern.
